// 时间格式化
function dateReplace(str, date) {
  if (str && str != "-") {
    return date
      ? "(" +
      date.substring(0, 4) +
      "-" +
      date.substring(4, 6) +
      "-" +
      date.substring(6) +
      ")"
      : "-";
  } else {
    return "";
  }
}

          etfList.getEtfList(1);

          $(".tab_main .tab_content:eq(3) .tab-link").html(str_tab_3);
          etfList.etfListParams.subClass = '06';
          etfList.getEtfList(1);
        }
        $('.tab-link button').on("click", function (e) {
          var v = $(e.target);//获取当前点击事件的元素
          $('button').attr("class", "btn btn-light btn-sm");
          $(this).addClass("btn-primary");
          $(this).removeClass("btn-light");
          etfList.etfListParams.subClass = $(this).val();
          etfList.getEtfList(1);
        })
      })
    })
  },
  /**
   * ETF类型转化
   * code 为接口FUND_LIST中返回字段subClass
   */
  typeConversion: function (code) {
    switch (code) {
      case '01':
        return '单市场股票（沪）ETF';
      case '02':
        return '单市场债券（沪）ETF';
      case '03':
        return '跨市场股票（沪深京）ETF';
      case '04':
        return '跨境ETF';
      case '05':
        return '交易型货币基金';
      case '06':
        return '黄金ETF';
      case '07':
        return '交易型货币基金';
      case '08':
        return '跨市场股票（沪深港京）ETF';
      case '09':
        return '单市场股票(科创板)ETF';
      case '31':
        return '跨市场股票(含科创板)ETF';
      case '32':
        return '跨市场债券（沪深）ETF';
      case '33':
        return '跨境ETF';
      case '34':
        return '多市场跨境ETF（日内回转）';
      case '35':
        return '多市场跨境ETF（非日内回转）';
      case '36':
        return '跨市场债券（银行间）ETF';
      case '37':
        return '现金申赎类债券ETF';
      case '38':
        return '商品期货ETF';
      case '11':
        return '普通LOF';
      case '12':
        return '财务分级LOF';
      case '13':
        return '多空分级LOF';
      case '14':

      case '15':

    }
  }
}

/**
 * @author JackCHEN
 * @version ${date} ${2022/04/21}
 * @method { dateNewReplace }
 * @param { String } date 时间
 * @param { String } type 回参类型对应 d == 日，m == 月 y == 年不传默认是日
 * @description 新增时间格式化工具，不会主动添加（）
 * @returns { Date } date
 */
function dateNewReplace(date, type) {
  switch (type) {
    case "d":
      return date && date != "-"
        ? date.substring(0, 4) +
        "-" +
        date.substring(4, 6) +
        "-" +
        date.substring(6)
        : date;
    case "m":
      return date && date != "-"
        ? date.substring(0, 4) + "-" + date.substring(4, 6)
        : date;
    case "y":
      return date && date != "-" ? date.substring(0, 4) : date;
    default:
      return date && date != "-"
        ? date.substring(0, 4) +
        "-" +
        date.substring(4, 6) +
        "-" +
        date.substring(6)
        : date;
  }
}
// 取两位小数,最后一位为0时不展示0
function stringFormatterTwo(d) {
  if (d == null || d == undefined || d == "null" || "" == d || "-" == d) {
    return "-";
  } else {
    if (d.indexOf(".") == -1) {
      return d;
    } else {
      if (d.substring(d.indexOf(".")).length > 1) {
        return parseFloat(parseFloat(d).toFixed(2));
      } else {
        return d;
      }
    }
  }
}
//返回参数处理
function retrunStr(str) {
  if (!str || str == "-") {
    return str;
  }
  return str;
}

var homeFundList = {
  //总览基金列表url
  fundListUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonSoaQuery.do",
  //总览基金列表参数
  fundListParams: {
    isPagination: true, //是否分页
    sqlId: "FUND_LIST",
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 5,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    fundType: "00",
    subClass: "01,02,03,04,06,08,09,31,32,33,34,35,36,37,38",
  },
  //总览etf规模url
  etfgmUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  //总览etf规模参数
  etfgmParams: {
    isPagination: true,
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_ZQPZ_ETFZL_XXPL_ETFGM_SEARCH_L",
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 5,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    STAT_DATE: "",
  },
  //信息披露参数
  infoParams: {
    sqlId: "COMMON_PL_JJXX_JJGG_L",
    isPagination: true,
    SECURITY_CODE: "",
    ORG_BULLETIN_TYPE: "",
    OTHER_TYPE: "",
    START_DATE: "",
    END_DATE: "",
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 5,
    "pageHelp.pageCount": 50,
    "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
    "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    "pageHelp.endPage": 5,
  },
  isfrist: true, // 每日默认首次访问
  // 成交概况总览参数
  cjgkListParam: {
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_SJ_GPSJ_CJGK_MRGK_C",
    PRODUCT_CODE: "05",
    isPagination: true,
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 10,
    "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
    "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
  },
  init: function () {
    this.getFundList(); //基金列表
    this.getetfgmCode(); //etf规模
    this.getcjgkList(); //成交概况
    this.getInfoList(); //信息披露
  },
  //获取基金列表数据
  getFundList: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="4">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var fundListHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    fundListHtml += "<th>基金代码</th>";
    fundListHtml += "<th>基金扩位简称</th>";
    fundListHtml += "<th>基金管理公司</th>";
    fundListHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.fundListUrl,
      data: _this.fundListParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            fundListHtml += "<tr>";
            fundListHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap"><a href="/assortment/fund/list/etfinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
              v.fundCode +
              '" target="_blank">' +
              v.fundCode +
              "</a></td>"; //基金代码
            fundListHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.secNameFull + "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
            fundListHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap"><a href="/assortment/fund/fundcompany/list/detail.shtml?COMPANYNAME=' +
              v.companyName +
              '" target="_blank">' +
              v.companyName +
              "</a></td>"; //基金管理公司
            fundListHtml += "</tr>";
          });
          fundListHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_homeFundList .table").html(fundListHtml);
        } else {
          fundListHtml += emptyTr;
          fundListHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_homeFundList .table").html(fundListHtml);
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        fundListHtml += emptyTr;
        fundListHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_homeFundList .table").html(fundListHtml);
      },
    });
  },
  getetfgmList: function (result) {
    var _this = this;
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="4">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var etfgmHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    etfgmHtml += "<th>基金代码</th>";
    etfgmHtml += "<th>基金扩位简称</th>";
    etfgmHtml += '<th class="text-right">总份额(万份)</th>';
    etfgmHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    var codes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
      codes.push(result[i].SEC_CODE + "");
    }
    getJSONP({
      url: sseQueryURL + "security/stock/queryExpandName.do",
      data: {
        secCodes: codes.join(","),
      },
      successCallback: function (callBackDatas) {
        var codemap = new Map();
        if (callBackDatas.result) {
          for (var ind = 0; ind < callBackDatas.result.length; ind++) {
            var data = callBackDatas.result;
            codemap.set(data[ind][0], data[ind][1]);
          }
        }
        if (result && result.length != 0) {
          var len = result.length <= 5 ? result.length : 5;
          for (var i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            var kwjc = codemap.get(result[i].SEC_CODE + "")
              ? codemap.get(result[i].SEC_CODE + "")
              : "-";
            var data = result[i];
            etfgmHtml += "<tr>";
            etfgmHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap"><a target="_blank" href="/assortment/fund/list/etfinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
              data.SEC_CODE +
              '">' +
              data.SEC_CODE +
              "</a></td>";
            etfgmHtml += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + kwjc + "</td>";
            etfgmHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap"><div class="text-right">' +
              data.TOT_VOL +
              "</div></td>";
            etfgmHtml += "</tr>";
          }
          if (result[0].STAT_DATE) {
            $(".js_etfgm .new_date").html(result[0].STAT_DATE);
          }
          etfgmHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_etfgm .table").html(etfgmHtml);
        } else {
          etfgmHtml += emptyTr;
          etfgmHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_etfgm .table").html(etfgmHtml);
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        etfgmHtml += emptyTr;
        etfgmHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_etfgm .table").html(etfgmHtml);
      },
    });
  },
  //获取etf规模code
  getetfgmCode: function () {
    var _this = this;
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.etfgmUrl,
      data: _this.etfgmParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        _this.getetfgmList(data.result);
      },
    });
  },
  getcjgkList: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="3">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var cjgkHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    cjgkHtml += "<th>单日情况</th>";
    cjgkHtml += '<th class="text-right">合计</th>';
    cjgkHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do?jsonCallBack=?",
      data: _this.cjgkListParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          cjgkHtml +=
            '<tr><td>市价总值(亿元)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            stringFormatterTwo(data.result[0].TOTAL_VALUE) +
            "</td></tr>";
          cjgkHtml +=
            '<tr><td>流通市值(亿元)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            stringFormatterTwo(data.result[0].NEGO_VALUE) +
            "</td></tr>";
          cjgkHtml +=
            '<tr><td>成交量(亿股)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            stringFormatterTwo(data.result[0].TRADE_VOL) +
            "</td></tr>";
          cjgkHtml +=
            '<tr><td>成交金额(亿元)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            stringFormatterTwo(data.result[0].TRADE_AMT) +
            "</td></tr>";
          cjgkHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_cjgk .table").html(cjgkHtml);
        } else {
          cjgkHtml += emptyTr;
          cjgkHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_cjgk .table").html(cjgkHtml);
        }
      },
    });
  },
  //获取信息披露数据
  getInfoList: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var infoHtml = "";
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.etfgmUrl,
      data: _this.infoParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            infoHtml +=
              '<li class="list-group-item"><a target="_blank" href="' +
              v.URL +
              '">' +
              v.TITLE +
              '</a><span class="new_date">' +
              v.SSEDATE +
              "</span></li>";
          });
          $(".js_homefundinfo ul").html(infoHtml);
        }
      },
    });
  },
};
if ($(".js_homeFundList").length > 0) {
  homeFundList.init();
}

var fundList = {
  fundListUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonSoaQuery.do",
  fundListParams: {
    isPagination: true,
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
    "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
    "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
    pagecache: false,
    sqlId: "FUND_LIST",
    fundType: "00",
    subClass: "01,02,03,04,06,08,09,31,32,33,34,35,36,37,38",
    order: "",
  },
  subClassOption: [
    {
      value: "01,02,03,04,06,08,09,31,32,33,34,35,36,37,38",
      name: "ETF",
    },
    {
      value: "",
      name: "实时申赎货币基金",
    },
    {
      value: "05,07",
      name: "交易型货币基金",
    },
    {
      value: "11,14,15",
      name: "LOF",
    },
    {
      value: "",
      name: "封闭式基金",
    },
    {
      value: "09,15,31",
      name: "20%涨跌幅比例基金",
    },
    {
      value: "12,13",
      name: "分级LOF",
    },
    {
      value: "",
      name: "当日回转交易基金",
    },
  ],
  fundTypeParams: ["00", "30", "00", "10", "40", "", "10", "drhz"],
  clickedIndex: 0, //下拉框所选下标
  init: function () {
    this.loadEvents();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    //接收参数改变选项
    var tabIndex = getWindowHref().tabActive;
    bootstrapSelect({
      method: function () {
        $(".js_type .selectpicker")
          .html(addSelectOption(_this.subClassOption))
          .selectpicker("refresh")
          .selectpicker("render");
        if (tabIndex) {
          $(".js_type option").eq(tabIndex).attr("selected", true);
          $(".js_type .selectpicker").selectpicker("refresh");
          _this.clickedIndex = tabIndex;
          _this.setFundListParam();
        } else {
          _this.setFundListParam();
        }
        //市场类型改变调用参数
        $(".js_type .selectpicker").on(
          "changed.bs.select",
          function (e, clickedIndex, isSelected, previousValue) {
            _this.clickedIndex = clickedIndex;
            _this.setFundListParam();
          }
        );
      },
    });
  },
  setFundListParam: function () {
    var _this = this;
    //选择实时申赎货币基金时
    if (_this.clickedIndex == 1) {
      _this.fundListUrl = sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do";
      _this.fundListParams = {
        isPagination: false,
        sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_ZQPZ_JJLB_SSSSHBJJLB_CPJBXX_L",
        FUND_TYPE: 30,
      };
      //当日回转交易基金
    } else if (_this.clickedIndex == 7) {
      _this.fundListUrl = sseQueryURL + "commonSoaQuery.do";
      _this.fundListParams = {
        isPagination: true,
        "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
        "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
        "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
        "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
        "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
        pagecache: false,
        sqlId: "FUND_LIST",
        swingTrade: "是",
      };
    } else {
      _this.fundListUrl = sseQueryURL + "commonSoaQuery.do";
      _this.fundListParams = {
        isPagination: true,
        "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
        "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
        "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
        "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
        "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
        pagecache: false,
        sqlId: "FUND_LIST",
        fundType: "00",
        subClass: "01,02,03,04,06,08,09,31",
        order: "",
      };
      //20%涨跌幅比例基金有排序参数
      if (_this.clickedIndex == 5) {
        _this.fundListParams.order = "fundType|asc,subClass|asc,fundCode|asc";
      } else {
        _this.fundListParams.order = "";
      }
      _this.fundListParams.subClass = $(".js_type .selectpicker").val();
      _this.fundListParams.fundType = _this.fundTypeParams[_this.clickedIndex];
    }
    //调用方法获取数据
    _this.getFundList(1);
  },
  getFundList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (!paginationChange(_this.fundListParams, pageIndex)) return; //触发分页改变分页参数
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="6">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var fundListHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    if (_this.clickedIndex == 0) {
      fundListHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth"><span>基金代码</span></th>';
      fundListHtml += "<th>基金扩位简称</th>";
      fundListHtml += "<th>ETF细分类型</th>";
      fundListHtml += "<th>基金管理人</th>";
    } else if (
      _this.clickedIndex == 3 ||
      _this.clickedIndex == 4 ||
      _this.clickedIndex == 6 ||
      _this.clickedIndex == 7
    ) {
      fundListHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth"><span>基金代码</span></th>';
      fundListHtml += "<th>基金扩位简称</th>";
      fundListHtml += "<th>基金管理人</th>";
    } else if (_this.clickedIndex == 1) {
      fundListHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth"><span>证券代码</span></th>';
      fundListHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth"><span>证券简称</span></th>';
    } else if (_this.clickedIndex == 2) {
      fundListHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth"><span>基金代码</span></th>';
      fundListHtml += "<th>基金扩位简称</th>";
      fundListHtml += "<th>基金管理人</th>";
      fundListHtml += '<th class="text-center">一级交易商名单</th>';
    } else if (_this.clickedIndex == 5) {
      fundListHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth"><span>基金类型</span></th>';
      fundListHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth"><span>基金代码</span></th>';
      fundListHtml += "<th>基金扩位简称</th>";
      fundListHtml += "<th>基金管理人</th>";
    }
    fundListHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.fundListUrl,
      data: _this.fundListParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            //封闭式基金、分级LOF
            if (_this.clickedIndex == 4 || _this.clickedIndex == 6) {
              fundListHtml += "<tr>";
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a href="' +
                _this.getPageUrl(v.fundType, v.subClass) +
                v.fundCode +
                '" target="_blank">' +
                v.fundCode +
                "</a></td>"; //基金代码
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.secNameFull + "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-nowrap"><a href="/assortment/fund/fundcompany/list/detail.shtml?COMPANYNAME=' +
                v.companyName +
                '" target="_blank">' +
                v.companyName +
                "</a></td>"; //基金管理人
              fundListHtml += "</tr>";
            } else if (_this.clickedIndex == 0) {
              //ETF
              fundListHtml += "<tr>";
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a href="' +
                _this.getPageUrl(v.fundType, v.subClass) +
                v.fundCode +
                '" target="_blank">' +
                v.fundCode +
                "</a></td>"; //基金代码
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.secNameFull + "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-nowrap">' + tab.typeConversion(v.subClass) + "</td>"; //ETF细分类型
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-nowrap"><a href="/assortment/fund/fundcompany/list/detail.shtml?COMPANYNAME=' +
                v.companyName +
                '" target="_blank">' +
                v.companyName +
                "</a></td>"; //基金管理人
              fundListHtml += "</tr>";
            } else if (
              _this.clickedIndex == 3 ||
              _this.clickedIndex == 7
            ) {
              //LOF、当日回转交易基金
              fundListHtml += "<tr>";
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a href="' +
                _this.getPageUrl(v.fundType, v.subClass) +
                v.fundCode +
                '" target="_blank">' +
                v.fundCode +
                "</a></td>"; //基金代码
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.secNameFull + "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-nowrap"><a href="/assortment/fund/fundcompany/list/detail.shtml?COMPANYNAME=' +
                v.companyName +
                '" target="_blank">' +
                v.companyName +
                "</a></td>"; //基金管理人
              fundListHtml += "</tr>";
              //实时申赎货币基金
            } else if (_this.clickedIndex == 1) {
              fundListHtml += "<tr>";
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td><a href="/assortment/fund/list/currencyfundinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
                v.FUND_CODE +
                '" target="_blank">' +
                v.FUND_CODE +
                "</a></td>"; //证券代码
              fundListHtml += "<td>" + v.FUND_ABBREVIATION + "</td>"; //证券简称
              fundListHtml += "</tr>";
              //交易型货币基金
            } else if (_this.clickedIndex == 2) {
              fundListHtml += "<tr>";
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a href="/assortment/fund/list/tcurrencyfundinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
                v.fundCode +
                '" target="_blank">' +
                v.fundCode +
                "</a></td>"; //基金代码
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.secNameFull + "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.companyName + "</td>"; //基金管理人
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-center"><a href="/assortment/fund/etf/list/etftradequa/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
                v.fundCode +
                "_" +
                v.fundAbbr +
                '" target="_blank"><i class="iconfont iconwenben"></i></a></td>'; //一级交易商名单
              fundListHtml += "</tr>";
            }
            //20%涨跌幅比例基金
            else if (_this.clickedIndex == 5) {
              var jjUrl =
                _this.getSUBCLASSName(v.subClass) == "科创板LOF"
                  ? "/assortment/fund/list/starlof/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID="
                  : "/assortment/fund/list/etfinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
              fundListHtml += "<tr>";
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-nowrap">' +
                _this.getSUBCLASSName(v.subClass) +
                "</td>";
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a href="' +
                jjUrl +
                v.fundCode +
                '" target="_blank">' +
                v.fundCode +
                "</a></td>"; //基金代码
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.secNameFull + "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
              fundListHtml +=
                '<td class="text-nowrap"><a href="/assortment/fund/fundcompany/list/detail.shtml?COMPANYNAME=' +
                v.companyName +
                '" target="_blank">' +
                v.companyName +
                "</a></td>"; //基金管理人
              fundListHtml += "</tr>";
            }
          });
          fundListHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_fundList .table").html(fundListHtml);
          //调用分页
          Page.navigation(
            ".js_fundList .pagination-box",
            data.pageHelp.pageCount,
            data.pageHelp.total,
            data.pageHelp.pageNo,
            data.pageHelp.pageSize,
            "fundList.getFundList"
          );
        } else {
          fundListHtml += emptyTr;
          fundListHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_fundList .table").html(fundListHtml);
          $(".js_fundList .pagination-box").html("");
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        fundListHtml += emptyTr;
        fundListHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_fundList .table").html(fundListHtml);
        $(".js_fundList .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
  //20%涨跌幅比例基金
  getSUBCLASSName: function (subclass) {
    var sUBCLASSName = "-";
    switch (subclass) {
      case "09":
        sUBCLASSName = "单市场科创板ETF";
        break;
      case "15":
        sUBCLASSName = "科创板LOF";
        break;
      case "31":
        sUBCLASSName = "跨市场科创板ETF";
        break;
    }
    return sUBCLASSName;
  },
  // 获取页面跳转链接
  getPageUrl: function (fundType, subClass) {
    var squrl = "";
    switch (fundType) {
      // ETF && 交易型货币基金
      case "00":
        if (
          subClass == "01" ||
          subClass == "02" ||
          subClass == "03" ||
          subClass == "04" ||
          subClass == "06" ||
          subClass == "08" ||
          subClass == "09" ||
          subClass == "31"
        ) {
          squrl = "/assortment/fund/list/etfinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
        } else if (
          subClass == "05" ||
          subClass == "07" ||
          subClass == "05,07"
        ) {
          squrl =
            "/assortment/fund/list/tcurrencyfundinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
        } else {
          squrl = "/assortment/fund/list/etfinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
        }
        break;
      // Reits
      case "50":
        squrl = "/assortment/fund/list/reits/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
        break;
      // 实时申赎货币基金
      case "30":
        squrl =
          "/assortment/fund/list/currencyfundinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
        break;
      // LOF && 分级LOF
      case "10":
        if (subClass == "11" || subClass == "14") {
          squrl = "/assortment/fund/list/lofinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
        } else if (subClass == "12" || subClass == "13") {
          squrl = "/assortment/fund/list/fjlofinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
        } else if (subClass == "15") {
          // 科创板 LOF
          squrl = "/assortment/fund/list/starlof/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
        }
        break;
      // 封闭式基金
      case "40":
        squrl = "/assortment/fund/list/closedinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
        break;
      // 20% 封闭式基金
      case "":
        if (subClass == "09") {
          squrl = "/assortment/fund/list/etfinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
        } else if (subClass == "15") {
          squrl = "/assortment/fund/list/starlof/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
        }
        break;
      default:
        squrl = "/assortment/fund/list/etfinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=";
        break;
    }
    return squrl;
  },
};
if ($(".js_fundList").length > 0) {
  fundList.init();
}
//基金列表end

var fundCompanyList = {
  fundCompanyListUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  fundCompanyListParams: {
    isPagination: true,
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
    "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
    "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_SJ_HYTJSJ_HYLB_HYXX_L",
    FULL_NAME: "",
    CMP_TYPE: 2,
    FULL_NAME_ASC: 1,
  },
  init: function () {
    this.loadEvents();
    this.getFundCompanyList(1);
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    $(".js_keywords input").attr("placeholder", "关键字");
    triggerSearch(_this.setFundCompanyList);
    $(".js_fundCompanyList").append(
      '<div class="remarks">上表中的信息仅针对在上海证券交易所挂牌交易的基金进行统计</div>'
    );
  },
  setFundCompanyList: function () {
    var _this = fundCompanyList;
    _this.fundCompanyListParams.FULL_NAME = $(".js_keywords input").val();
    _this.getFundCompanyList(1);
  },
  getFundCompanyList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (!paginationChange(_this.fundCompanyListParams, pageIndex)) return; //触发分页改变分页参数
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="3">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var fundCompanyListHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    fundCompanyListHtml += "<th>基金管理公司</th>";
    fundCompanyListHtml += "<th>联系电话</th>";
    fundCompanyListHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.fundCompanyListUrl,
      data: _this.fundCompanyListParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          var website = "";
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            fundCompanyListHtml += "<tr>";
            fundCompanyListHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap"><a href="/assortment/fund/fundcompany/list/detail.shtml?COMPANYNAME=' +
              v.FULL_NAME +
              '" target="_blank">' +
              v.FULL_NAME +
              "</a></td>"; //基金管理公司
            fundCompanyListHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.LINKMAN_TEL + "</td>"; //联系电话
            fundCompanyListHtml += "</tr>";
          });
          fundCompanyListHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_fundCompanyList .table").html(fundCompanyListHtml);
          //调用分页
          Page.navigation(
            ".js_fundCompanyList .pagination-box",
            data.pageHelp.pageCount,
            data.pageHelp.total,
            data.pageHelp.pageNo,
            data.pageHelp.pageSize,
            "fundCompanyList.getFundCompanyList"
          );
        } else {
          fundCompanyListHtml += emptyTr;
          fundCompanyListHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_fundCompanyList .table").html(fundCompanyListHtml);
          $(".js_fundCompanyList .pagination-box").html("");
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        fundCompanyListHtml += emptyTr;
        fundCompanyListHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_fundCompanyList .table").html(fundCompanyListHtml);
        $(".js_fundCompanyList .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
};
if ($(".js_fundCompanyList").length > 0) {
  fundCompanyList.init();
}

var relatedFund = {
  companyName: decodeURIComponent(getWindowHref().COMPANYNAME).substr(0, 4), //url参数
  relatedFundUrl1: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  relatedFundParams1: {
    isPagination: false,
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_SJ_HYTJSJ_HYLB_HYXX_L",
    FULL_NAME: "",
  },
  init: function () {
    this.loadEvents();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    _this.relatedFundParams1.FULL_NAME = _this.companyName;
    _this.requestRelatedFundList();
  },
  requestRelatedFundList: function () {
    var _this = this;
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.relatedFundUrl1,
      data: _this.relatedFundParams1,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        var data = data;
        _this.getData(data);
      },
    });
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="6">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var fbsjjHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    fbsjjHtml += "<th>基金代码</th>";
    fbsjjHtml += "<th>基金简称</th>";
    fbsjjHtml += '<th class="text-right">基金续存期</th>';
    fbsjjHtml += "<th>上市日期</th>";
    fbsjjHtml += '<th class="text-right">发行份数(亿)</th>';
    fbsjjHtml += "<th>基金类型</th>";
    fbsjjHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.relatedFundUrl1,
      data: {
        isPagination: true,
        sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_ZQPZ_JJGSLB_JJGLGSGK_QXGLDFBSJJ_L",
        COMPANYNAME: _this.companyName,
      },
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            fbsjjHtml += "<tr>";
            fbsjjHtml +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a href="/assortment/fund/list/closedinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
              v.FUNDID +
              '" target="_blank">' +
              v.FUNDID +
              "</a></td>"; //基金代码
            fbsjjHtml +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a href="/assortment/fund/list/closedinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
              v.FUNDID +
              '" target="_blank">' +
              v.ABBR +
              "</a></td>"; //基金简称
            fbsjjHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + v.SAVE_DATE + "</td>"; //基金续存期
            fbsjjHtml += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.LISTING_DATE + "</td>"; //上市日期
            fbsjjHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + v.ISSUE_COLLUMN + "</td>"; //发行份数(亿)
            if (v.CLASS == "" || v.CLASS == null || v.CLASS == undefined) {
              fbsjjHtml += "<td>-</td>"; //基金类型
            } else {
              fbsjjHtml += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.CLASS + "</td>"; //基金类型
            }
          });
          fbsjjHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_fbsjj .table").html(fbsjjHtml);
        } else {
          fbsjjHtml += emptyTr;
          fbsjjHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_fbsjj .table").html(fbsjjHtml);
        }
      },
    });
  },
  getData: function (data, data1) {
    if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
      var result = data.result[0];
      var relatedFundHtml = "<tbody><tr>";
      //单位全称
      if (
        result.FULL_NAME == undefined ||
        result.FULL_NAME == null ||
        result.FULL_NAME == ""
      ) {
        result.FULL_NAME = "-";
      }
      //注册地址
      if (
        result.ADDRESS == undefined ||
        result.ADDRESS == null ||
        result.ADDRESS == ""
      ) {
        result.ADDRESS = "-";
      }
      relatedFundHtml +=
        '<td class="text-nowrap">单位全称：</td><td class="text-nowrap">' +
        result.FULL_NAME +
        '</td><td class="text-nowrap">注册地址：</td><td class="text-nowrap">' +
        result.ADDRESS +
        "</td></tr>";
      //总经理
      if (
        result.PRESIDENT_NAME == undefined ||
        result.PRESIDENT_NAME == null ||
        result.PRESIDENT_NAME == ""
      ) {
        result.PRESIDENT_NAME = "-";
      }
      //联系人
      if (
        result.LINKMAN_NAME == undefined ||
        result.LINKMAN_NAME == null ||
        result.LINKMAN_NAME == ""
      ) {
        result.LINKMAN_NAME = "-";
      }
      relatedFundHtml +=
        '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">总经理：</td><td>' +
        result.PRESIDENT_NAME +
        '</td><td class="text-nowrap">联系人：</td><td class="text-nowrap">' +
        result.LINKMAN_NAME +
        "</td></tr>";
      //联系电话
      if (
        result.LINKMAN_TEL == undefined ||
        result.LINKMAN_TEL == null ||
        result.LINKMAN_TEL == ""
      ) {
        result.LINKMAN_TEL = "-";
      }
      //联系传真
      if (
        result.COMP_FAX == undefined ||
        result.COMP_FAX == null ||
        result.COMP_FAX == ""
      ) {
        result.COMP_FAX = "-";
      }
      relatedFundHtml +=
        '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">联系电话：</td><td>' +
        result.LINKMAN_TEL +
        '</td><td class="text-nowrap">联系传真：</td><td class="text-nowrap">' +
        result.COMP_FAX +
        "</td></tr></tbody>";
    } else {
      var relatedFundHtml = "<tbody><tr>";
      relatedFundHtml +=
        "<tr><td>单位全称：<td><td>-</td><td>注册地址：</td><td>-</td></tr>";
      relatedFundHtml +=
        "<tr><td>总经理：<td><td>-</td><td>联系人：</td><td>-</td></tr>";
      relatedFundHtml +=
        "<tr><td>联系电话：<td><td>-</td><td>联系传真：</td><td>-</td></tr></tbody>";
    }
    $(".js_relatedFund .table").html(relatedFundHtml);
  },
};
if ($(".js_relatedFund").length > 0) {
  relatedFund.init();
}

var jjzsslb = {
  jjzsslbUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  jjzsslbParams: {
    isPagination: true,
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
    "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
    "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_CP_JJ_JJZSSLB_JJZSSLB",
  },
  init: function () {
    this.getjjzsslbList(1);
  },
  getjjzsslbList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (!paginationChange(_this.jjzsslbParams, pageIndex)) return; //触发分页改变分页参数
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="2">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var jjzsslbHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    jjzsslbHtml += "<th>编号</th>";
    jjzsslbHtml += "<th>做市商名称（按首字母排序）</th>";
    jjzsslbHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    var downUrl = sseQueryURL + "commonExcelDd.do?sqlId=COMMON_SSE_CP_JJ_JJZSSLB_JJZSSLB";
    var downHtm = '<a class="tableDownload js_download_market" href="' + downUrl + '">' + "下载</a>";
    if ($('.js_download_market').length > 0) {
      $('.js_download_market').attr('href', downUrl);
    } else {
      $(".title_lev2 .new_date").after(downHtm);
    }
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.jjzsslbUrl,
      data: _this.jjzsslbParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            jjzsslbHtml += "<tr>";
            jjzsslbHtml += "<td>" + v.NUM + "</td>";
            jjzsslbHtml += "<td>" + v.FIRM_NAME + "</td>";
            jjzsslbHtml += "</tr>";
          });
          jjzsslbHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_jjzsslb .table").html(jjzsslbHtml);
          //调用分页
          Page.navigation(
            ".js_jjzsslb .pagination-box",
            data.pageHelp.pageCount,
            data.pageHelp.total,
            data.pageHelp.pageNo,
            data.pageHelp.pageSize,
            "jjzsslb.getjjzsslbList"
          );
        } else {
          jjzsslbHtml += emptyTr;
          jjzsslbHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_jjzsslb .table").html(jjzsslbHtml);
          $(".js_jjzsslb .pagination-box").html("");
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        jjzsslbHtml += emptyTr;
        jjzsslbHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_jjzsslb .table").html(jjzsslbHtml);
        $(".js_jjzsslb .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
};
if ($(".js_jjzsslb").length > 0) {
  jjzsslb.init();
}

/**
 * 基金产品做市商列表
 */
var jjcpzsslb = {
  jjcpzsslbUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  jjcpzsslbParams: {
    isPagination: true,
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
    "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
    "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_CP_JJ_JJZSSLB_JJCPZSSLB",
    securityCode: "",
    firmName: "",
  },
  init: function () {
    $(".js_keywords input").attr("placeholder", "关键字");
    this.getjjcpzsslbList(1);
    triggerSearch(this.setjjcpzsslbParams); //点击搜索、回车触发查询
  },
  setjjcpzsslbParams: function () {
    var _this = jjcpzsslb;
    var keywords = $(".js_keywords input").val();
    var num6 = /^\d{6}$/;
    //关键字为数字时,securityCode有值，firmName无值
    if (num6.test(keywords)) {
      _this.jjcpzsslbParams.securityCode = keywords;
      _this.jjcpzsslbParams.firmName = "";
      _this.getjjcpzsslbList(1);
      //securityCode无值，firmName有值
    } else if ($.trim(keywords).length) {
      _this.jjcpzsslbParams.securityCode = "";
      _this.jjcpzsslbParams.firmName = keywords;
      _this.getjjcpzsslbList(1);
    } else {
      bootstrapModal({
        text: "请输入正确的基金代码或做市商名称",
      });
      return false;
    }
  },
  getjjcpzsslbList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (!paginationChange(_this.jjcpzsslbParams, pageIndex)) return; //触发分页改变分页参数
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="4">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var jjcpzsslbHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    jjcpzsslbHtml += "<th>基金代码</th>";
    jjcpzsslbHtml += "<th>基金扩位简称</th>";
    jjcpzsslbHtml += "<th>做市商名称</th>";
    jjcpzsslbHtml += "<th>做市服务类型</th>";
    jjcpzsslbHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    var downUrl = sseQueryURL + "commonExcelDd.do?sqlId=COMMON_SSE_CP_JJ_JJZSSLB_JJCPZSSLB" + "&securityCode=" + _this.jjcpzsslbParams.securityCode + "&firmName=" + _this.jjcpzsslbParams.firmName;
    var downHtm = '<a class="tableDownload js_download_market" href="' + downUrl + '">' + "下载</a>";
    if ($('.js_download_market').length > 0) {
      $('.js_download_market').attr('href', downUrl);
    } else {
      $(".title_lev2 .new_date").after(downHtm);
    }
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.jjcpzsslbUrl,
      data: _this.jjcpzsslbParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            jjcpzsslbHtml += "<tr>";
            jjcpzsslbHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.SECURITY_CODE + "</td>"; //基金代码
            jjcpzsslbHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.SEC_NAME_FULL + "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
            jjcpzsslbHtml += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.FIRM_NAME + "</td>"; //做市商名称
            jjcpzsslbHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.SERVICE_TYPE + "</td>"; //做市服务类型
            jjcpzsslbHtml += "</tr>";
          });
          jjcpzsslbHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_jjcpzsslb .table").html(jjcpzsslbHtml);
          //调用分页
          Page.navigation(
            ".js_jjcpzsslb .pagination-box",
            data.pageHelp.pageCount,
            data.pageHelp.total,
            data.pageHelp.pageNo,
            data.pageHelp.pageSize,
            "jjcpzsslb.getjjcpzsslbList"
          );
        } else {
          jjcpzsslbHtml += emptyTr;
          jjcpzsslbHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_jjcpzsslb .table").html(jjcpzsslbHtml);
          $(".js_jjcpzsslb .pagination-box").html("");
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        jjcpzsslbHtml += emptyTr;
        jjcpzsslbHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_jjcpzsslb .table").html(jjcpzsslbHtml);
        $(".js_jjcpzsslb .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
};
if ($(".js_jjcpzsslb").length > 0) {
  jjcpzsslb.init();
}

var etfList = {
  etfListUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonSoaQuery.do",
  etfListParams: {
    isPagination: true,
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
    "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
    "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
    pagecache: false,
    sqlId: "FUND_LIST",
    fundType: "00",
    subClass: "01",
  },
  dscEtfParams: {
    isPagination: true,
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 15,
    "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
    "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
    pagecache: false,
    sqlId: "FUND_LIST",
    fundType: "00",
    subClass: "09",
  },
  kscEtfParams: {
    isPagination: true,
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 15,
    "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
    "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
    pagecache: false,
    sqlId: "FUND_LIST",
    fundType: "00",
    subClass: "31",
  },
  typeOption: [
    {
      value: "01",
      name: "单市场ETF",
    },
    {
      value: "03,08",
      name: "跨市场ETF",
    },
    {
      value: "04",
      name: "跨境ETF",
    },
    {
      value: "02,32",
      name: "债券ETF",
    },
    {
      value: "06",
      name: "黄金ETF",
    },
    {
      value: "09,31",
      name: "科创板相关ETF",
    },
  ],
  init: function () {
    this.getEtfList(1);
    this.loadEvents();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    $(".js_kscetf").hide();
    //下拉框添加数据
    bootstrapSelect({
      method: function () {
        //类型渲染下拉框
        $(".js_type .selectpicker")
          .html(addSelectOption(_this.typeOption))
          .selectpicker("refresh")
          .selectpicker("render");
        //触发查询
        $(".js_type .selectpicker").on("changed.bs.select", function (e) {
          var selectVal = $(".js_type .selectpicker").val();
          if (selectVal == "09,31") {
            $(".js_kscetf").show();
            $(".js_etfList").prepend(
              '<h2 class="title_lev2">单市场科创板ETF</h2>'
            );
            $(".js_kscetf").prepend(
              '<h2 class="title_lev2">跨市场科创板ETF</h2>'
            );
            _this.getdscEtfList(1);
            _this.getkscEtfList(1);
          } else {
            $(".js_kscetf").hide();
            $(".js_etfList .title_lev2").remove();
            $(".js_kscetf .title_lev2").remove();
            _this.etfListParams.subClass = selectVal;
            _this.getEtfList(1);
          }
        });
      },
    });
  },
  getEtfList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (!paginationChange(_this.etfListParams, pageIndex)) return; //触发分页改变分页参数
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="5">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var etfListHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    etfListHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth">基金代码</th>';
    etfListHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">基金扩位简称</th>';
    etfListHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">基金管理人</th>';
    etfListHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap text-center">一级交易商名单</th>';
    etfListHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.etfListUrl,
      data: _this.etfListParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            etfListHtml += "<tr>";
            etfListHtml +=
              '<td class="align-middle codeNameWidth"><a href="/assortment/fund/list/etfinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
              v.fundCode +
              '" target="_blank">' +
              v.fundCode +
              "</a></td>"; //基金代码
            etfListHtml +=
              '<td class="align-middle text-nowrap">' + v.secNameFull + "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
            etfListHtml +=
              '<td class="align-middle text-nowrap"><a href="/assortment/fund/fundcompany/list/detail.shtml?COMPANYNAME=' +
              v.companyName +
              '" target="_blank">' +
              v.companyName +
              "</a></td>"; //基金管理人
            etfListHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-center"><a href="/assortment/fund/etf/list/etftradequa/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
              v.fundCode +
              "_" +
              v.fundAbbr +
              '" target="_blank"><i class="iconfont iconwenben"></i></a></td>'; //一级交易商名单
            etfListHtml += "</tr>";
          });
          etfListHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_etfList .table").html('');
          var paginationDOM = ".js_etfList .pagination-box";
          $(paginationDOM).html("");
          if (etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '01' || etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '03' || etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '08' || etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '09' || etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '31') {
            $(".js_etfList .table:eq(0)").html(etfListHtml);
            paginationDOM = ".js_etfList .pagination-box:eq(0)";
          } else if (etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '02' || etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '32' || etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '36' || etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '37') {
            $(".js_etfList .table:eq(1)").html(etfListHtml);
            paginationDOM = ".js_etfList .pagination-box:eq(1)";
          } else if (etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '33' || etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '34' || etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '35') {
            $(".js_etfList .table:eq(2)").html(etfListHtml);
            paginationDOM = ".js_etfList .pagination-box:eq(2)";
          } else if (etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '06' || etfList.etfListParams.subClass == '38') {
            $(".js_etfList .table:eq(3)").html(etfListHtml);
            paginationDOM = ".js_etfList .pagination-box:eq(3)";
          }
          //调用分页
          Page.navigation(
            paginationDOM,
            data.pageHelp.pageCount,
            data.pageHelp.total,
            data.pageHelp.pageNo,
            data.pageHelp.pageSize,
            "etfList.getEtfList"
          );
        } else {
          etfListHtml += emptyTr;
          etfListHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_etfList .table").html(etfListHtml);
          $(".js_etfList .pagination-box").html("");
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        etfListHtml += emptyTr;
        etfListHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_etfList .table").html(etfListHtml);
        $(".js_etfList .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
  getdscEtfList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (!paginationChange(_this.dscEtfParams, pageIndex)) return; //触发分页改变分页参数
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="5">暂无数据</td></tr>';

          );

      },

/**
 * etf专项业务资格

var etftradequa = {
  etftradequaUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  etftradequaParams: {
    isPagination: true,
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
    "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
    "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_CP_JJLB_YJJYS_L",
    FUNDID2: "",
  },
  init: function () {
    this.loadEvents();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var fundTitle = decodeURIComponent(
      getWindowHref().FUNDID.split("_")[1] || " "
    );
    $(".title_lev2").html(fundTitle + "：一级交易商名单");
    _this.etftradequaParams.FUNDID2 = getWindowHref().FUNDID.split("_")[0];
    this.getetftradequaList(1);
  },
  getetftradequaList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (!paginationChange(_this.etftradequaParams, pageIndex)) return; //触发分页改变参数

    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="2">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var etftradequaHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    etftradequaHtml += "<th>序号</th>";
    etftradequaHtml += "<th>公司名称</th>";
    etftradequaHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.etftradequaUrl,
      data: _this.etftradequaParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            etftradequaHtml += "<tr>";
            etftradequaHtml += "<td>" + v.NUM + "</td>";
            etftradequaHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.FULL_NAME + "</td>";
            etftradequaHtml += "</tr>";
          });
          etftradequaHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_etftradequa .table").html(etftradequaHtml);
          //调用分页
          Page.navigation(
            ".js_etftradequa .pagination-box",
            data.pageHelp.pageCount,
            data.pageHelp.total,
            data.pageHelp.pageNo,
            data.pageHelp.pageSize,
            "etftradequa.getetftradequaList"
          );
        } else {
          etftradequaHtml += emptyTr;
          $(".js_etftradequa .table").html(etftradequaHtml);
          $(".js_etftradequa .pagination-box").html("");
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        etftradequaHtml += emptyTr;
        $(".js_etftradequa .table").html(etftradequaHtml);
        $(".js_etftradequa .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
  getQueryString: function (t, e) {
    var code = /<(S*?)[^%3C|<]*%3C|<.*?|%3E|>.*?/;

    var i = new RegExp("[&,?]" + t + "=([^\\&]*)", "i"),
      n = i.exec(e || location.href);
    if (code.test(n[1])) {
      return n ? n[1].replace(/%3C|<|%3E|>|%20/g, "") : "";
    } else {
      return n ? n[1] : "";
    }
  },
};
if ($(".js_etftradequa").length > 0) {
  etftradequa.init();
}
//etf专项业务资格end

/**
 * 二级市场成交概况
 */
var overview = {
  overviewDayUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do", //每日情况url
  //每日情况参数
  overviewDayParams: {
    SEARCH_DATE: "",
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_SJ_GPSJ_CJGK_MRGK_C",
    PRODUCT_CODE: 13,
  },
  //月度情况url
  overviewMonthUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  //月度情况参数
  overviewMonthParams: {
    PRODUCT_CODE: 13,
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_SJ_GPSJ_CJGK_MYGK_C",
    SEARCH_DATE: "",
  },
  //年度情况url
  overviewYearUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  //年度情况参数
  overviewYearParams: {
    PRODUCT_CODE: 13,
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_SJ_GPSJ_CJGK_MNGK_C",
    SEARCH_YEAR: "",
  },
  lastTradeDate: get_lastTradeDate_global(), //上一个交易日
  init: function () {
    $(".js_overviewDay .js_dateDay input").attr("placeholder", "请选择时间");
    $(".js_overviewMonth .js_dateMonth input").attr(
      "placeholder",
      "请选择时间"
    );
    $(".js_overviewYear .js_dateYear input").attr("placeholder", "请选择时间");
    this.loadEvents();
    this.getOverviewDayList();
    this.getOverviewMonthList();
    this.getOverviewYearList();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    //获取上个月日期
    var preMonth = changeFormatDate(_this.lastTradeDate, 0, -1, 0).substr(0, 7);
    //获取上一年
    var preYear = changeFormatDate(_this.lastTradeDate, 0, 0, -1).substr(0, 4);
    //每日情况日期渲染
    laydate({
      elem: ".js_dateDay input",
      theme: "#b50005",
      format: "yyyy-MM-dd",
      isInitValue: false,
      min: "1990-12-19",
      trigger: "click",
      value: get_lastTradeDate_global(),
      btns: ["confirm"],
      done: function (value, date, endDate) {
        //选择时间触发查询
        _this.overviewDayParams.SEARCH_DATE = value;
        _this.getOverviewDayList();
      },
    });
    //月度情况日期渲染
    laydate({
      elem: ".js_dateMonth input",
      theme: "#b50005",
      format: "yyyy-MM-dd",
      min: "1999-01-01",
      type: "month",
      isInitValue: false,
      value: preMonth,
      max: _this.lastTradeDate.substr(0, 7),
      trigger: "click",
      btns: ["confirm"],
      done: function (value, date, endDate) {
        //选择时间触发查询
        _this.overviewMonthParams.SEARCH_DATE = value;
        _this.getOverviewMonthList();
      },
    });
    //年度情况日期渲染
    laydate({
      elem: ".js_dateYear input",
      theme: "#b50005",
      format: "yyyy-MM-dd",
      min: "1999-01-01",
      type: "year",
      isInitValue: false,
      max: _this.lastTradeDate.substr(0, 4),
      value: preYear,
      trigger: "click",
      btns: ["confirm"],
      done: function (value, date, endDate) {
        //选择时间触发查询
        _this.overviewYearParams.SEARCH_YEAR = value;
        _this.getOverviewYearList();
      },
    });
  },
  //每日情况数据获取
  getOverviewDayList: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="2">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var overviewDayHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    overviewDayHtml += "<th>单日情况</th>";
    overviewDayHtml += '<th class="text-right">合计</th>';
    overviewDayHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.overviewDayUrl,
      data: _this.overviewDayParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          var result = data.result[0];
          var dataTime = dateNewReplace(result.TRADE_DATE);
          $(".js_overviewDay .js_dateDay input").val(dataTime);
          overviewDayHtml +=
            '<tr><td>挂牌数</td><td class="text-right">' +
            sseUtil.ifZeroTurn(result.LIST_NUM) +
            "</td></tr>";
          overviewDayHtml +=
            '<tr><td>成交量(亿份)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            sseUtil.ifZeroTurn(result.TRADE_VOL) +
            "</td></tr>";
          overviewDayHtml +=
            '<tr><td>成交金额(亿元)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            sseUtil.ifZeroTurn(result.TRADE_AMT) +
            "</td></tr>";
          overviewDayHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_overviewDay .table").html(overviewDayHtml);
        } else {
          overviewDayHtml += emptyTr;
          $(".js_overviewDay .table").html(overviewDayHtml);
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        overviewDayHtml += emptyTr;
        $(".js_overviewDay .table").html(overviewDayHtml);
      },
    });
  },
  //月度情况数据获取
  getOverviewMonthList: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="2"">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var overviewMonthHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    overviewMonthHtml += "<th>月度情况</th>";
    overviewMonthHtml += '<th class="text-right">合计</th>';
    overviewMonthHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.overviewMonthUrl,
      data: _this.overviewMonthParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          var result = data.result[0];
          var dataTime = dateNewReplace(result.DATA_DATE, "m");
          $(".js_overviewMonth .js_dateMonth input").val(dataTime);
          overviewMonthHtml +=
            '<tr><td class="align-middle">挂牌数</td><td class="text-right">' +
            sseUtil.ifZeroTurn(result.LIST_NUM) +
            "</td></tr>";
          overviewMonthHtml +=
            '<tr><td class="align-middle">成交金额(亿元)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            sseUtil.ifZeroTurn(result.TRADE_AMT) +
            "</td></tr>";
          overviewMonthHtml +=
            '<tr><td class="align-middle">最高成交金额(亿元)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            sseUtil.ifZeroTurn(result.M_HIGH_AMT) +
            "</br>" +
            dateReplace(result.M_HIGH_AMT, result.M_HIGH_AMT_DATE) +
            "</td></tr>";
          overviewMonthHtml +=
            '<tr><td class="align-middle">最低成交金额(亿元)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            sseUtil.ifZeroTurn(result.M_LOW_AMT) +
            "</br>" +
            dateReplace(result.M_LOW_AMT, result.M_LOW_AMT_DATE) +
            "</td></tr>";
          overviewMonthHtml +=
            '<tr><td class="align-middle">成交量(亿份)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            sseUtil.ifZeroTurn(result.TRADE_VOL) +
            "</td></tr>";
          overviewMonthHtml +=
            '<tr><td class="align-middle">最高成交量(亿份)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            sseUtil.ifZeroTurn(result.M_HIGH_VOL) +
            "</br>" +
            dateReplace(result.M_HIGH_VOL, result.M_HIGH_VOL_DATE) +
            "</td></tr>";
          overviewMonthHtml +=
            '<tr><td class="align-middle">最低成交量(亿份)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            sseUtil.ifZeroTurn(result.M_LOW_VOL) +
            "</br>" +
            dateReplace(result.M_LOW_VOL, result.M_LOW_VOL_DATE) +
            "</td></tr>";
          overviewMonthHtml +=
            '<tr><td class="align-middle">累计交易天数(天)</td><td class="text-right">' +
            sseUtil.ifZeroTurn(result.TRADE_DAYS) +
            "</td></tr>";
          overviewMonthHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_overviewMonth .table").html(overviewMonthHtml);
        } else {
          overviewMonthHtml += emptyTr;
          $(".js_overviewMonth .table").html(overviewMonthHtml);
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        overviewMonthHtml += emptyTr;
        $(".js_overviewMonth .table").html(overviewMonthHtml);
      },
    });
  },
  //年度情况数据获取
  getOverviewYearList: function () {

var currencyfund = {
  currencyfundUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  currencyfundParams: {
    isPagination: false,
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_ZQPZ_JJLB_SSSSHBJJLB_CPJBXX_L",
    FUND_TYPE: 30,
  },
  init: function () {
    if ($(".js_productInfo").length > 0) {
      this.getcurrencyfundList();
    }
    if ($(".js_basicinfo").length > 0) {
      this.getBasicInfoList();
    }
  },
  getcurrencyfundList: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="2">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var currencyfundHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    currencyfundHtml += '<th class="text-center">证券代码</th>';
    currencyfundHtml += '<th class="text-center">证券简称</th>';
    currencyfundHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.currencyfundUrl,
      data: _this.currencyfundParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            currencyfundHtml += "<tr>";
            currencyfundHtml +=
              '<td class="text-center"><a href="/assortment/fund/list/currencyfundinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              '" target="_blank">' +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              "</a></td>";
            currencyfundHtml +=
              '<td class="text-center">' + v.FUND_ABBREVIATION + "</td>";
            currencyfundHtml += "</tr>";
          });
          currencyfundHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_productInfo .table").html(currencyfundHtml);
        } else {
          currencyfundHtml += emptyTr;
          currencyfundHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_productInfo .table").html(currencyfundHtml);
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        currencyfundHtml += emptyTr;
        currencyfundHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_productInfo .table").html(currencyfundHtml);
      },
    });
  },
  getBasicInfoList: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="12"></td></tr>';
    var basicinfoHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    basicinfoHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth">证券代码</th>';
    basicinfoHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth">证券简称</th>';
    basicinfoHtml += "<th>基金管理公司</th>";
    basicinfoHtml += '<th class="text-right">最新净赎回上限</th>';
    basicinfoHtml += '<th class="text-right">最新净申购上限</th>';
    basicinfoHtml += '<th class="text-right">最新总赎回上限</th>';
    basicinfoHtml += '<th class="text-right">最新总申购上限</th>';
    basicinfoHtml += '<th class="text-right">最新单账户净赎回上限</th>';
    basicinfoHtml += '<th class="text-right">最新单账户净申购上限</th>';
    basicinfoHtml += '<th class="text-right">最新单账户总赎回上限</th>';
    basicinfoHtml += '<th class="text-right">最新单账户总申购上限</th>';
    basicinfoHtml +=
      '<th class="text-right">不受基金级赎回限制的小额账户标准</th>';
    basicinfoHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.currencyfundUrl,
      data: _this.currencyfundParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            basicinfoHtml += "<tr>";
            basicinfoHtml +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><span>' + v.FUND_CODE + "</span></td>"; //证券代码
            basicinfoHtml +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><span>' +
              v.FUND_ABBREVIATION +
              "</span></td>"; //证券简称
            basicinfoHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.COMPANY_NAME + "</td>"; //
            basicinfoHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' + v.SELL_LIMIT + "</td>"; //
            basicinfoHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' + v.BUY_LIMIT + "</td>"; //
            basicinfoHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' +
              v.SELL_LIMIT_SUM +
              "</td>"; //
            basicinfoHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' + v.BUY_LIMIT_SUM + "</td>"; //
            basicinfoHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' + v.ONESELL_LIMIT + "</td>"; //
            basicinfoHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' + v.ONEBUY_LIMIT + "</td>"; //
            basicinfoHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' +
              v.ONESELL_LIMIT_SUM +
              "</td>"; //
            basicinfoHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' +
              v.ONEBUY_LIMIT_SUM +
              "</td>"; //
            basicinfoHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' + v.OTHERS + "</td>"; //
            basicinfoHtml += "</tr>";
          });
          basicinfoHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_basicinfo .table").html(basicinfoHtml);
          var date = data.result[0].FILE_DATE;
          $(".js_basicinfo .new_date").html(
            "数据日期：" + date.substring(0, 4) + "年" + date.substring(4, 6) + "月" + date.substring(6, 8) + "日日末，次一交易日生效"
          );
        } else {
          basicinfoHtml += emptyTr;
          basicinfoHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_basicinfo .table").html(basicinfoHtml);
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        basicinfoHtml += emptyTr;
        basicinfoHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_basicinfo .table").html(basicinfoHtml);
      },
    });
  },
};

}

var tcurrencyfund = {
  tcurrencyfundUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonSoaQuery.do",
  tcurrencyfundParams: {
    isPagination: true,
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
    "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
    "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
    sqlId: "FUND_LIST",
    fundType: "00",
    subClass: "05,07",
  },
  init: function () {
    this.gettcurrencyfundList(1);
  },
  gettcurrencyfundList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (!paginationChange(_this.tcurrencyfundParams, pageIndex)) return; //触发分页改变分页参数
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="5">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var tcurrencyfundHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    tcurrencyfundHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth">基金代码</th>';
    tcurrencyfundHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">基金扩位简称</th>';
    tcurrencyfundHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">基金管理人</th>';
    tcurrencyfundHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">一级交易商名单</th>';
    tcurrencyfundHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.tcurrencyfundUrl,
      data: _this.tcurrencyfundParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            tcurrencyfundHtml += "<tr>";
            tcurrencyfundHtml +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a href="/assortment/fund/list/tcurrencyfundinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
              v.fundCode +
              '" target="_blank">' +
              v.fundCode +
              "</a></td>"; //基金代码
            tcurrencyfundHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.secNameFull + "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
            tcurrencyfundHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.companyName + "</td>"; //基金管理人
            tcurrencyfundHtml +=
              '<td><a href="/assortment/fund/etf/list/etftradequa/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
              v.fundCode +
              "_" +
              v.fundAbbr +
              '" target="_blank">详情</a></td>'; //一级交易商名单
            tcurrencyfundHtml += "</tr>";
          });
          tcurrencyfundHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_tcurrencyfund .table").html(tcurrencyfundHtml);
          //调用分页
          Page.navigation(
            ".js_tcurrencyfund .pagination-box",
            data.pageHelp.pageCount,
            data.pageHelp.total,
            data.pageHelp.pageNo,
            data.pageHelp.pageSize,
            "tcurrencyfund.gettcurrencyfundList"
          );
        } else {
          tcurrencyfundHtml += emptyTr;
          tcurrencyfundHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_tcurrencyfund .table").html(tcurrencyfundHtml);
          $(".js_tcurrencyfund .pagination-box").html("");
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        tcurrencyfundHtml += emptyTr;
        tcurrencyfundHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_tcurrencyfund .table").html(tcurrencyfundHtml);
        $(".js_tcurrencyfund .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
};

 * 上市开放式基金（LOF）

var lofHome = {
  lofHomeUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonSoaQuery.do",
  lofHomeParams: {
    isPagination: true,
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
    "pageHelp.pageNo": 1,
    "pageHelp.beginPage": 1,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    "pageHelp.endPage": 1,
    sqlId: "FUND_LIST",
    fundType: "10",
    subClass: "11,14,15",
  },
  init: function () {
    this.getLofHomeList(1);
    this.loadEvents();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    $(".js_navTabs").on("click", "span", function () {
      var subClass = $(this).attr("data-value");
      _this.lofHomeParams.subClass = subClass;
      _this.getLofHomeList(1);
    });
  },
  getLofHomeList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    //获取点击tab的下标
    var tabIndex = $(".js_navTabs .active").index();
    //params:当前接口的参数，分页传过来的当前页，当前数据列表分页的父级元素
    if (
      !paginationChange(
        _this.lofHomeParams,
        pageIndex,
        ".tab_content:eq(" + tabIndex + ")"
      )
    )
      return; //修改分页参数
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="4">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var lofHomeHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    lofHomeHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth">基金代码</th>';
    lofHomeHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">基金扩位简称</th>';
    lofHomeHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">基金管理公司</th>';
    lofHomeHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      url: _this.lofHomeUrl,
      data: _this.lofHomeParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            lofHomeHtml += "<tr>";
            lofHomeHtml +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a href="/assortment/fund/list/lofinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
              v.fundCode +
              '" target="_blank">' +
              v.fundCode +
              "</a></td>"; //基金代码
            lofHomeHtml += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.secNameFull + "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
            lofHomeHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap"><a href="/assortment/fund/fundcompany/list/detail.shtml?COMPANYNAME=' +
              v.companyName +
              '" target="_blank">' +
              v.companyName +
              "</a></td>"; //基金管理公司
            lofHomeHtml += "</tr>";
          });
          lofHomeHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".tab_content").eq(tabIndex).find(".table").html(lofHomeHtml);
        } else {
          lofHomeHtml += emptyTr;
          lofHomeHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".tab_content").eq(tabIndex).find(".table").html(lofHomeHtml);
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        lofHomeHtml += emptyTr;
        lofHomeHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".tab_content").eq(tabIndex).find(".table").html(lofHomeHtml);
      },
    });
  },
};
if ($(".js_kcblof").length > 0) {
  lofHome.init();
}

/**
 * 上市开放式基金净值
 */
var fundNetWorth = {
  commonUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  commonParam: {
    isPagination: true,
    assessDate: "",
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_CP_JJ_JZ_L",
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    pagecache: false,
    type1: 1,
  },
  typeOption: [
    //下拉框数据
    {
      name: "LOF净值（涨跌幅10%）",
      value: "1",
    },
    {
      name: "科创板相关LOF净值（涨跌幅20%）",
      value: "5",
    },
  ],
  toHref01: "/assortment/fund/list/lofinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=",
  toHref02: "/assortment/fund/list/starlof/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=",
  init: function () {
    this.loadEvents();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    //净值类型下拉框数据渲染
    bootstrapSelect({
      method: function () {
        //净值类型数据渲染
        $(".js_type .selectpicker")
          .html(addSelectOption(_this.typeOption))
          .selectpicker("refresh")
          .selectpicker("render");
        $(".js_type .selectpicker").on("loaded.bs.select", function (e) {
          _this.setFundParam();
        });
        //下拉框改变触发查询
        $(".js_type .selectpicker").on("changed.bs.select", function (e) {
          _this.setFundParam();
        });
      },
    });
    $(".js_date input").attr("placeholder", "查询日期");
    //加载日历插件
    laydate({
      elem: ".js_date input",
      theme: "#b50005",
      format: "yyyy-MM-dd",
      min: "1990-12-19",
      max: get_systemDate_global(),
      trigger: "click",
      btns: ["confirm"],
      done: function (value, date, endDate) {
        setTimeout(function () {
          _this.setFundParam();
        }, 500);
      },
    });
  },
  //设置参数
  setFundParam: function () {
    var _this = this;
    _this.commonParam.type1 = $(".js_type .selectpicker").val();
    var dateStr = $(".js_date input").val();
    _this.commonParam.assessDate = dateStr.replace(/-/g, "");
    _this.getFundList(1);
  },
  //获取列表数据
  getFundList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (!paginationChange(_this.commonParam, pageIndex)) return; //触发分页改变分页参数
    var htm =
      '<thead><tr><th>基金代码</th><th>基金扩位简称</th><th>估值日期</th><th class="text-right">基金单位净值（元）</th></tr></thead>';
    htm += "<tbody>";
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="5">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.commonParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          var squrl =
            data.result[0].PRODUCT_TYPE == "1"
              ? _this.toHref01
              : _this.toHref02;
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            if (k == 0) {
              $(".js_date input").val(v.ASSESS_DATE);
            }
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a target="_blank" href="' +
              squrl +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              '">' +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              "</a></td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.SEC_NAME_FULL + "</td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.ASSESS_DATE + "</td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + v.NAV + "</td>";
            htm += "</tr>";
          });
          Page.navigation(
            ".js_fundNetWorth .pagination-box",
            data.pageHelp.pageCount,
            data.pageHelp.total,
            data.pageHelp.pageNo,
            data.pageHelp.pageSize,
            "fundNetWorth.getFundList"
          );
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
          $(".js_fundNetWorth .pagination-box").html("");
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_fundNetWorth .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_fundNetWorth .table").html(htm);
        $(".js_fundNetWorth .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
};
if ($(".js_fundNetWorth").length > 0) {
  fundNetWorth.init();
}
//上市开放式基金净值 end

/**
 * 上市开放式基金净值（新）
 */
var fundNetWorth_new = {
  commonUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  commonParam: {
    isPagination: true,
    PRODUCT_TYPE: "11,14",//基金产品类型
    SEARCH_DATE: "",//查询日期
    'type': 'inParams',
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_CP_JJ_LOF_SSKFSJJJZ_L",
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    pagecache: false,
  },
  typeOption: [
    //下拉框数据
    {
      name: "LOF净值（涨跌幅10%）",
      value: "11,14",
    },
    {
      name: "科创板相关LOF净值（涨跌幅20%）",
      value: "15",
    },
  ],
  toHref01: "/assortment/fund/list/lofinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=",
  toHref02: "/assortment/fund/list/starlof/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=",
  init: function () {
    this.loadEvents();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    //净值类型下拉框数据渲染
    bootstrapSelect({
      method: function () {
        //净值类型数据渲染
        $(".js_type .selectpicker")
          .html(addSelectOption(_this.typeOption))
          .selectpicker("refresh")
          .selectpicker("render");
        $(".js_type .selectpicker").on("loaded.bs.select", function (e) {
          _this.setFundParam();
        });
        //下拉框改变触发查询
        $(".js_type .selectpicker").on("changed.bs.select", function (e) {
          _this.setFundParam();
        });
      },
    });
    $(".js_date input").attr("placeholder", "查询日期");
    //加载日历插件
    laydate({
      elem: ".js_date input",
      theme: "#b50005",
      format: "yyyy-MM-dd",
      min: "1990-12-19",
      max: get_systemDate_global(),
      trigger: "click",
      btns: ["confirm"],
      done: function (value, date, endDate) {
        setTimeout(function () {
          _this.setFundParam();
        }, 500);
      },
    });
  },
  //设置参数
  setFundParam: function () {
    var _this = this;
    _this.commonParam.PRODUCT_TYPE = $(".js_type .selectpicker").val();
    var dateStr = $(".js_date input").val();
    _this.commonParam.SEARCH_DATE = dateStr.replace(/-/g, "");
    _this.getFundList(1);
  },
  //获取列表数据
  getFundList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (!paginationChange(_this.commonParam, pageIndex)) return; //触发分页改变分页参数
    var htm =
      '<thead><tr><th>基金代码</th><th>基金扩位简称</th><th>估值日期</th><th class="text-right">基金单位净值（元）</th></tr></thead>';
    htm += "<tbody>";
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="5">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.commonParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          var squrl =
            data.result[0].PRODUCT_TYPE == "1"
              ? _this.toHref01
              : _this.toHref02;
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            if (k == 0) {
              $(".js_date input").val(v.ASSESS_DATE);
            }
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a target="_blank" href="' +
              squrl +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              '">' +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              "</a></td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.SEC_NAME_FULL + "</td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.ASSESS_DATE + "</td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + v.NAV + "</td>";
            htm += "</tr>";
          });
          Page.navigation(
            ".js_fundNetWorth_2022 .pagination-box",
            data.pageHelp.pageCount,
            data.pageHelp.total,
            data.pageHelp.pageNo,
            data.pageHelp.pageSize,
            "fundNetWorth_new.getFundList"
          );
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
          $(".js_fundNetWorth_2022 .pagination-box").html("");
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_fundNetWorth_2022 .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_fundNetWorth_2022 .table").html(htm);
        $(".js_fundNetWorth_2022 .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
};
if ($(".js_fundNetWorth_2022").length > 0) {
  fundNetWorth_new.init();
}

var scaleStatistics = {
  commonUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  commonParam: {
    isPagination: true,
    tradeDate: "",
    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_CP_JJ_GM_L",
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 25,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
    pagecache: false,
    type1: 1,
  },
  typeOption: [
    //下拉框数据
    {
      name: "LOF规模（涨跌幅10%）",
      value: "1",
    },
    {
      name: "科创板相关LOF规模（涨跌幅20%）",
      value: "5",
    },
  ],
  toHref01: "/assortment/fund/list/lofinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=",
  toHref02: "/assortment/fund/list/starlof/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=",
  init: function () {
    this.loadEvents();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    //净值类型下拉框数据渲染
    bootstrapSelect({
      method: function () {
        //净值类型数据渲染
        $(".js_type .selectpicker")
          .html(addSelectOption(_this.typeOption))
          .selectpicker("refresh")
          .selectpicker("render");
        $(".js_type .selectpicker").on("loaded.bs.select", function (e) {
          _this.setFundParam();
        });
        //下拉框改变触发查询
        $(".js_type .selectpicker").on("changed.bs.select", function (e) {
          _this.setFundParam();
        });
      },
    });
    $(".js_date input").attr("placeholder", "查询日期");
    //加载日历插件
    laydate({
      elem: ".js_date input",
      theme: "#b50005",
      format: "yyyy-MM-dd",
      min: "1990-12-19",
      max: get_systemDate_global(),
      trigger: "click",
      btns: ["confirm"],
      done: function (value, date, endDate) {
        setTimeout(function () {
          _this.setFundParam();
        }, 500);
      },
    });
  },
  //设置参数
  setFundParam: function () {
    var _this = this;
    _this.commonParam.type1 = $(".js_type .selectpicker").val();
    var dateStr = $(".js_date input").val();
    _this.commonParam.tradeDate = dateStr.replace(/-/g, "");
    _this.getFundList(1);
  },
  //获取列表数据
  getFundList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (!paginationChange(_this.commonParam, pageIndex)) return; //触发分页改变分页参数
    var htm =
      '<thead><tr><th>交易日期</th><th>基金代码</th><th>基金扩位简称</th><th class="text-right">基金规模（万份）</th></tr></thead>';
    htm += "<tbody>";
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="5">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.commonParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          var squrl =
            data.result[0].PRODUCT_TYPE == "1"
              ? _this.toHref01
              : _this.toHref02;
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            if (k == 0) {
              $(".js_date input").val(turnDateAddLine(v.TRADE_DATE));
            }
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.TRADE_DATE + "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a target="_blank" href="' +
              squrl +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              '">' +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              "</a></td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.SEC_NAME_FULL + "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + v.INTERNAL_VOL + "</td>";
            htm += "</tr>";
          });
          Page.navigation(
            ".js_scaleStatistics .pagination-box",
            data.pageHelp.pageCount,
            data.pageHelp.total,
            data.pageHelp.pageNo,
            data.pageHelp.pageSize,
            "scaleStatistics.getFundList"
          );
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
          $(".js_scaleStatistics .pagination-box").html("");
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_scaleStatistics .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_scaleStatistics .table").html(htm);
        $(".js_scaleStatistics .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
};
if ($(".js_scaleStatistics").length > 0) {
  scaleStatistics.init();
}

  commonUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
