    sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_FUND_FJLOF_NETVALUE_CX_S",
    FILEDATE: "",
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 10000,
    "pageHelp.cacheSize": 1,
  },
  toHref: "/assortment/fund/list/fjlofinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=",
  init: function () {
    this.loadEvents();
    this.setFundParam();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    $(".js_date input").attr("placeholder", "查询日期");
    //加载日历插件
    laydate({
      elem: ".js_date input",
      theme: "#b50005",
      format: "yyyy-MM-dd",
      min: "1990-12-19",
      max: get_systemDate_global(),
      value: get_systemDate_global(),
      trigger: "click",
      btns: ["confirm"],
      done: function (value, date, endDate) {
        setTimeout(function () {
          _this.setFundParam();
        }, 500);
      },
    });
  },
  //设置参数
  setFundParam: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var dateStr = $(".js_date input").val()
      ? $(".js_date input").val()
      : get_systemDate_global();
    _this.commonParam.FILEDATE = dateStr.replace(/-/g, "");
    _this.getFundList();
  },
  getFundList: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var htm =
      '<thead><tr><th>基金代码</th><th>基金简称</th><th>估值日期</th><th class="text-right">基金单位净值(元)</th></tr></thead>';
    htm += "<tbody>";
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="5">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.commonParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a target="_blank" href="' +
              _this.toHref +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              "&ABBR=" +
              data.FUND_ABBR +
              '">' +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              "</a></td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a target="_blank" href="' +
              _this.toHref +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              "&ABBR=" +
              data.FUND_ABBR +
              '">' +
              v.FUND_ABBR +
              "</a></td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.ASSESS_DATE + "</td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + v.NAV + "</td>";
            htm += "</tr>";
          });
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_gradeFundNetWorth .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_gradeFundNetWorth .table").html(htm);
      },
    });
  },
};

var gradeScaleStatistics = {
  commonUrl: sseQueryURL + "commonQuery.do",
  commonParam: {
    isPagination: true,
    sqlId: "",
    FILEDATE: "",
    "pageHelp.pageSize": 10000,
  },
  typeOption: [
    {
      name: "分级LOF场内规模统计",
      value: "COMMON_SSE_FUND_FJLOF_SCALE_CX_S",
    },
    {
      name: "分拆合并统计",
      value: "COMMON_SSE_FUND_FJLOF_SM_CX_S",
    },
  ],
  toHref: "/assortment/fund/fjlof/home/index_detal.shtml?FUNDID=",
  init: function () {
    this.loadEvents();
    this.getStaticList();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    bootstrapSelect({
      method: function () {
        $(".js_type .selectpicker")
          .html(addSelectOption(_this.typeOption))
          .selectpicker("refresh")
          .selectpicker("render");
        //统计类型改变调用参数
        $(".js_type .selectpicker").on("changed.bs.select", function (e) {
          _this.setFundParam();
        });
      },
    });
    $(".js_date input").attr("placeholder", "查询日期");
    //加载日历插件
    laydate({
      elem: ".js_date input",
      theme: "#b50005",
      format: "yyyy-MM-dd",
      value: get_systemDate_global(),
      min: "1990-12-19",
      max: get_systemDate_global(),
      trigger: "click",
      btns: ["confirm"],
      done: function (value, date, endDate) {
        setTimeout(function () {
          _this.setFundParam();
        }, 500);
      },
    });
    $(".js_gradeScaleStatistics").append(
      '<div class="remarks"><span>注：以上份额数据为当日收盘清算后，次日开盘前份额数据</span></div>'
    );
    setTimeout(function () {
      _this.setFundParam();
    }, 500);
  },
  //设置参数
  setFundParam: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var dateStr = $(".js_date input").val();
    _this.commonParam.sqlId = $(".js_type .selectpicker").val();
    _this.commonParam.FILEDATE = dateStr.replace(/-/g, "");
    if (_this.commonParam.sqlId == "COMMON_SSE_FUND_FJLOF_SCALE_CX_S") {
      _this.getSplitFundList();
    } else {
      _this.getFundList();
    }
  },
  //获取分级LOF场内规模统计
  getFundList: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var htm =
      '<thead><tr><th>交易日期</th><th>基金代码</th><th>基金简称</th><th class="text-right">基金规模（万份）</th></tr></thead>';
    htm += "<tbody>";
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="10">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.commonParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.TRADE_DATE + "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a target="_blank" href="' +
              _this.toHref +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              '">' +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              "</a></td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a target="_blank" href="' +
              _this.toHref +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              '">' +
              v.FUND_ABBR +
              "</a></td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + v.INTERNAL_VOL + "</td>";
            htm += "</tr>";
          });
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_gradeScaleStatistics .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_gradeScaleStatistics .table").html(htm);
      },
    });
  },
  //分拆合并统计
  getSplitFundList: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var htm =
      '<thead><tr><th>交易日期</th><th>基金代码</th><th>基金简称</th><th class="text-right">分拆总份额（万份）</th><th class="text-right">合并总份额（万份）</th></tr></thead>';
    htm += "<tbody>";
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="10">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.commonParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.TRADE_DATE + "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a target="_blank" href="' +
              _this.toHref +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              '">' +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              "</a></td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a target="_blank" href="' +
              _this.toHref +
              v.FUND_CODE +
              '">' +
              v.FUND_ABBR +
              "</a></td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + v.SPLIT_VOL + "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + v.MERGE_VOL + "</td>";
            htm += "</tr>";
          });
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_gradeScaleStatistics .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_gradeScaleStatistics .table").html(htm);
      },
    });
  },
};
if ($(".js_gradeScaleStatistics").length > 0) {
  gradeScaleStatistics.init();
}

/**
 * 封闭式发行与扩募
 */
var closedFundIssuance = {
  init: function () {
    this.getfxList(tableData["tableData_1211"]);
    this.getkmList(tableData["tableData_1291"]);
  },
  getfxList: function (data) {
    var _this = this;
    var fxHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    fxHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">基金代码</th>';
    fxHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">基金简称</th>';
    fxHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">发行方式</th>';
    fxHtml += '<th class="text-right text-nowrap">发行日期</th>';
    fxHtml += '<th class="text-right text-nowrap">上市日期</th>';
    fxHtml += '<th class="text-right text-nowrap">发行份数(亿份)</th>';
    fxHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    if (data.list.length > 1) {
      $.each(data.list, function (k, v) {
        if (v) {
          fxHtml += "<tr>";
          fxHtml += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v[0] + "</td>"; //基金代码
          fxHtml += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v[1] + "</td>"; //基金简称
          fxHtml += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v[2] + "</td>"; //扩募上市日
          fxHtml += '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' + v[3] + "</td>"; //配售比例
          fxHtml += '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' + v[4] + "</td>"; //配售价
          fxHtml += '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' + v[5] + "</td>"; //扩募份额
          fxHtml += "</tr>";
        }
      });
    } else {
      fxHtml += data.list[0];
    }
    $(".js_fx .table").html(fxHtml);
  },
  getkmList: function (data) {
    var _this = this;
    var kmHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    kmHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">基金代码</th>';
    kmHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">基金简称</th>';
    kmHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">扩募上市日</th>';
    kmHtml += '<th class="text-right text-nowrap">配售比例</th>';
    kmHtml += '<th class="text-right text-nowrap">配售价</th>';
    kmHtml += '<th class="text-right text-nowrap">扩募份额(亿份)</th>';
    kmHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    if (data.list.length > 1) {
      $.each(data.list, function (k, v) {
        if (v) {
          kmHtml += "<tr>";
          kmHtml += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v[0] + "</td>"; //基金代码
          kmHtml += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v[1] + "</td>"; //基金简称
          kmHtml += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v[2] + "</td>"; //扩募上市日
          kmHtml += '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' + v[3] + "</td>"; //配售比例
          kmHtml += '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' + v[4] + "</td>"; //配售价
          kmHtml += '<td class="text-right text-nowrap">' + v[5] + "</td>"; //扩募份额
          kmHtml += "</tr>";
        }
      });
    } else {
      kmHtml += data.list[0];
    }
    $(".js_km .table").html(kmHtml);
  },
};
if ($(".js_fx").length > 0) {
  closedFundIssuance.init();
}

/**
 * ETF行情

var etfprice = {
  etfpriceUrl: hq_queryUrl + "v1/sh1/list/exchange/ebs",
  etfpriceparams: {
    select:
      "code,name,open,high,low,last,prev_close,chg_rate,volume,amount,cpxxextendname,tradephase",
  },
  pageSize: 25,
  pageIndex: 1,
  init: function () {
    this.loadEvents();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    clearInterval(freshTime);
    var freshTime = window.setInterval(function () {
      _this.getEtfpriceList(_this.pageIndex);
    }, 15000);
    _this.getEtfpriceList(1);
  },
  getEtfpriceList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    pageIndex = dynaGetData(null, pageIndex);
    if (isNaN(pageIndex)) {
      return false;
    }
    _this.pageIndex = pageIndex;
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="12">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var etfpriceHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    etfpriceHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth">证券代码</th>';
    etfpriceHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">基金扩位简称</th>';
    etfpriceHtml += '<th class="text-right">开盘价</th>';
    etfpriceHtml += '<th class="text-right">最高价</th>';
    etfpriceHtml += '<th class="text-right">最低价</th>';
    etfpriceHtml += '<th class="text-right">当前价</th>';
    etfpriceHtml += '<th class="text-right">前日收盘价</th>';
    etfpriceHtml += '<th class="text-right">涨跌幅</th>';
    etfpriceHtml += '<th class="text-right">成交量(手)</th>';
    etfpriceHtml += '<th class="text-right">成交额(万元)</th>';
    etfpriceHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.etfpriceUrl,
      data: _this.etfpriceparams,
      jsonp: "callback",
      successCallback: function (data) {
        var dataDate = data.date + "";
        var dataTime = data.time + "";
        if (dataTime.length == 5) {
          dataTime = "0" + data.time;
        }
        if (dataDate && dataTime)
          $(".new_date").html(
            "更新时间： " +
            turnDateAddLine(dataDate + "") +
            " " +
            dataTime.substring(0, 2) +
            ":" +
            dataTime.substring(2, 4) +
            ":" +
            dataTime.substring(4, 6)
          );
        if (
          !data ||
          (data && !data.list) ||
          (data && data.list && data.list.length == 0)
        ) {
          etfpriceHtml += emptyTr;
          etfpriceHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_etfprice .table").html(etfpriceHtml);
          $(".js_etfprice .pagination-box").html("");
          return false;
        }
        var total = data.total,
          pageCount = Math.ceil(total / _this.pageSize);
        for (
          var i = (pageIndex - 1) * _this.pageSize;
          i < pageIndex * _this.pageSize;
          i++
        ) {
          var v = data.list[i];
          if (v) {
            etfpriceHtml += "<tr>";
            etfpriceHtml +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a href="/assortment/fund/list/etfinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
              v[0] +
              '" target="_blank">' +
              v[0] +
              "</a></td>"; //证券代码
            etfpriceHtml +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' + (v[10] ? v[10] : "-") + "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
            etfpriceHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right ' +
              Comparative(v[2], v[6]) +
              '">' +
              (v[2] && v[2].toFixed(3) >= 0 ? v[2].toFixed(3) : "--") +
              "</td>"; //开盘价
            etfpriceHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right ' +
              Comparative(v[3], v[6]) +
              '">' +
              (v[3] && v[3].toFixed(3) >= 0 ? v[3].toFixed(3) : "--") +
              "</td>"; //最高价
            etfpriceHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right ' +
              Comparative(v[4], v[6]) +
              '">' +
              (v[4] && v[4].toFixed(3) >= 0 ? v[4].toFixed(3) : "--") +
              "</td>"; //最低价
            etfpriceHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right ' +
              Comparative(v[5], v[6]) +
              '">' +
              (v[5] && v[5].toFixed(3) >= 0 ? v[5].toFixed(3) : "--") +
              "</td>"; //当前价
            etfpriceHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right">' +
              (v[6] ? v[6].toFixed(3) : "0.000") +
              "</td>"; //前日收盘价
            etfpriceHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right ' +
              Comparative(v[7], 0) +
              '">' +
              (v[7] ? v[7].toFixed(2) : "0.00") +
              "%</td>"; //涨跌幅
            etfpriceHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right">' + (v[8] / 100).toFixed(0) + "</td>"; //成交量(手)
            etfpriceHtml +=
              '<td class="text-right">' + (v[9] / 10000).toFixed(3) + "</td>"; //成交额(万元)
            etfpriceHtml += "</tr>";
          }
        }
        etfpriceHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_etfprice .table").html(etfpriceHtml);
        Page.navigation(
          ".js_etfprice .pagination-box",
          pageCount,
          total,
          pageIndex,
          _this.pageSize,
          "etfprice.getEtfpriceList"
        );
        $(".js_etfprice .pagination-box .change-pageSize").remove();
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        etfpriceHtml += emptyTr;
        etfpriceHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_etfprice .table").html(etfpriceHtml);
        $(".js_etfprice .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
};
if ($(".js_etfprice").length > 0) {
  etfprice.init();
}
//ETF行情 END

/**
 * 上市开放式基金行情

var lofmarket = {
  lofmarketUrl: hq_queryUrl + "/v1/sh1/list/exchange/lof",
  lofmarketParams: {},
  selfUrl: hq_queryUrl + "v1/sh1/list/self/",
  selfParams: {
    select: "code,name,open,high,low,last,prev_close,chg_rate,volume,amount",
  },
  expandNameUrl:
    sseQueryURL + "security/stock/queryExpandName.do?jsonCallBack=?",
  expandNameParams: {
    secCodes: "",
  },
  pageIndex: 1,
  pageSize: 25,
  init: function () {
    this.loadEvents();
  },
  loadEvents: function () {
    var _this = this;
    clearInterval(freshTime);
    var freshTime = window.setInterval(function () {
      _this.getLofMarketList(_this.pageIndex);
    }, 15000);
    _this.getLofMarketList(1);
  },
  getLofMarketList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    pageIndex = dynaGetData(null, pageIndex);
    if (isNaN(pageIndex)) {
      return false;
    }
    _this.pageIndex = pageIndex;
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="12">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var lofmarketHtml = "<thead><tr>";
    lofmarketHtml += '<th class="codeNameWidth">证券代码</th>';
    lofmarketHtml += '<th class="text-nowrap">基金扩位简称</th>';
    lofmarketHtml += '<th class="text-right">开盘价</th>';
    lofmarketHtml += '<th class="text-right">最高价</th>';
    lofmarketHtml += '<th class="text-right">最低价</th>';
    lofmarketHtml += '<th class="text-right">当前价</th>';
    lofmarketHtml += '<th class="text-right">前日收盘价</th>';
    lofmarketHtml += '<th class="text-right">涨跌幅</th>';
    lofmarketHtml += '<th class="text-right">成交量(手)</th>';
    lofmarketHtml += '<th class="text-right">成交额(万元)</th>';
    lofmarketHtml += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.lofmarketUrl,
      data: _this.lofmarketParams,
      jsonp: "callback",
      successCallback: function (data) {
        var dataDate = data.date + "";
        var dataTime = data.time + "";
        if (dataTime.length == 5) {
          dataTime = "0" + data.time;
        }
        if (dataDate && dataTime)
          $(".new_date").html(
            "更新时间： " +
            turnDateAddLine(dataDate + "") +
            " " +
            dataTime.substring(0, 2) +
            ":" +
            dataTime.substring(2, 4) +
            ":" +
            dataTime.substring(4, 6)
          );
        if (
          !data ||
          (data && !data.list) ||
          (data && data.list && data.list.length == 0)
        ) {
          lofmarketHtml += emptyTr;
          lofmarketHtml += "</tbody>";
          $(".js_etfprice .table").html(lofmarketHtml);
          $(".js_etfprice .pagination-box").html("");
          return false;
        }
        var total = data.total,
          pageCount = Math.ceil(total / _this.pageSize),
          dataCode = [];
        for (
          var i = (pageIndex - 1) * _this.pageSize;
          i < pageIndex * _this.pageSize;
          i++
        ) {
          var v = data.list[i];
          if (v) {
            dataCode.push(v[0]);
          }
        }
        if (dataCode && dataCode.length > 0) {
          //获取code信息
          getJSONP({
            type: "post",
            dataType: "jsonp",
            url: _this.selfUrl + dataCode.join("_"),
            data: _this.selfParams,
            jsonp: "callback",
            successCallback: function (codeData) {
              //返回为空
              if (
                !codeData ||
                (codeData && !codeData.list) ||
                (codeData && codeData.list && codeData.list.length == 0)
              ) {
                lofmarketHtml += emptyTr;
                lofmarketHtml += "</tbody>";
                $(".js_etfprice .table").html(lofmarketHtml);
                $(".js_etfprice .pagination-box").html("");
                return false;
              }
              //获取扩展名信息
              _this.expandNameParams.secCodes = dataCode.join(",");
              getJSONP({
                type: "post",
                dataType: "jsonp",
                url: _this.expandNameUrl,
                data: _this.expandNameParams,
                jsonp: "callback",
                successCallback: function (expandNameData) {
                  //返回为空
                  if (
                    !expandNameData ||
                    (expandNameData && !expandNameData.result) ||
                    (expandNameData &&
                      expandNameData.result &&
                      expandNameData.result.length == 0)
                  ) {
                    lofmarketHtml += emptyTr;
                    lofmarketHtml += "</tbody>";
                    $(".js_etfprice .table").html(lofmarketHtml);
                    $(".js_etfprice .pagination-box").html("");
                    return false;
                  }
                  codeData = codeData.list;
                  expandNameData = expandNameData.result;
                  $.each(codeData, function (k, v) {
                    lofmarketHtml += "<tr>";
                    lofmarketHtml +=
                      '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a href="/assortment/fund/list/lofinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
                      v[0] +
                      '" target="_blank">' +
                      v[0] +
                      "</a></td>"; //证券代码
                    lofmarketHtml +=
                      '<td class="text-nowrap">' +
                      (expandNameData[k] && expandNameData[k][1]
                        ? expandNameData[k][1]
                        : "--") +
                      "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
                    lofmarketHtml +=
                      '<td class="text-right ' +
                      Comparative(v[2], v[6]) +
                      '">' +
                      (v[2] && v[2].toFixed(3) >= 0
                        ? v[2].toFixed(3)
                        : "0.000") +
                      "</td>"; //开盘价
                    lofmarketHtml +=
                      '<td class="text-right ' +
                      Comparative(v[3], v[6]) +
                      '">' +
                      (v[3] && v[3].toFixed(3) >= 0
                        ? v[3].toFixed(3)
                        : "0.000") +
                      "</td>"; //最高价
                    lofmarketHtml +=
                      '<td class="text-right ' +
                      Comparative(v[4], v[6]) +
                      '">' +
                      (v[4] && v[4].toFixed(3) >= 0
                        ? v[4].toFixed(3)
                        : "0.000") +
                      "</td>"; //最低价
                    lofmarketHtml +=
                      '<td class="text-right ' +
                      Comparative(v[5], v[6]) +
                      '">' +
                      (v[5] && v[5].toFixed(3) >= 0
                        ? v[5].toFixed(3)
                        : "0.000") +
                      "</td>"; //当前价
                    lofmarketHtml +=
                      '<td class="text-right">' +
                      (v[6] ? v[6].toFixed(3) : "0.000") +
                      "</td>"; //前日收盘价
                    lofmarketHtml +=
                      '<td class="text-right ' +
                      Comparative(v[7], 0) +
                      '">' +
                      (v[7] ? v[7].toFixed(2) : "0.00") +
                      "%</td>"; //涨跌幅
                    lofmarketHtml +=
                      '<td class="text-right">' +
                      (v[8] / 100).toFixed(0) +
                      "</td>"; //成交量(手)
                    lofmarketHtml +=
                      '<td class="text-right">' +
                      (v[9] / 10000).toFixed(3) +
                      "</td>"; //成交额(万元)
                    lofmarketHtml += "</tr>";
                  });
                  lofmarketHtml += "</tbody>";
                  $(".js_lofmarket .table").html(lofmarketHtml);
                  Page.navigation(
                    ".js_lofmarket .pagination-box",
                    pageCount,
                    total,
                    pageIndex,
                    _this.pageSize,
                    "lofmarket.getLofMarketList"
                  );
                  $(".js_lofmarket .pagination-box .change-pageSize").remove();
                },
                errCallback: function () {
                  lofmarketHtml += emptyTr;
                  lofmarketHtml += "</tbody>";
                  $(".js_lofmarket .table").html(lofmarketHtml);
                  $(".js_lofmarket .pagination-box").html("");
                },
              });
            },
            errCallback: function () {
              lofmarketHtml += emptyTr;
              lofmarketHtml += "</tbody>";
              $(".js_lofmarket .table").html(lofmarketHtml);
              $(".js_lofmarket .pagination-box").html("");
            },
          });
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        lofmarketHtml += emptyTr;
        lofmarketHtml += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_lofmarket .table").html(lofmarketHtml);
        $(".js_lofmarket .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
};
if ($(".js_lofmarket").length > 0) {
  lofmarket.init();
}

/**
 * ETF专栏首页 -- ETF行情

var etfQuotes = {
  codes: "510050_510180_510300_510010_510020_510060",
  etfUrl: hq_queryUrl + "/v1/sh1/list/self/",
  etfParam: {
    select: "code,name,last,chg_rate,volume,amount,prev_close,cpxxextendname",
  },
  init: function () {
    var _this = this;
    _this.getEtfList();
    window.setInterval(function () {
      _this.getEtfList();
    }, 60000);
  },
  getEtfList: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var htm =
      '<thead><tr><th>代码</th><th>基金扩位简称</th><th class="text-right">当前价</th><th class="text-right">涨跌幅</th><th class="text-right">成交额(万元)</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="18">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "POST",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.etfUrl + _this.codes,
      data: _this.etfParam,
      jsonp: "callback",
      successCallback: function (data) {
        var nowTime = "" + data.time;
        if (nowTime.length == 5) {
          nowTime = "0" + data.time;
        }
        var _sysDateTime = data.date + "" + nowTime;
        //更新时间
        $(".js_etfQuotes .new_date").html(
          "更新时间： " +
          _sysDateTime.substring(0, 4) +
          "-" +
          _sysDateTime.substring(4, 6) +
          "-" +
          _sysDateTime.substring(6, 8) +
          " " +
          _sysDateTime.substring(8, 10) +
          ":" +
          _sysDateTime.substring(10, 12) +
          ":" +
          _sysDateTime.substring(12)
        );
        if (data && data.list.length > 0) {
          $.each(data.list, function (k, v) {
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="codeNameWidth"><a target="_blank" href="/assortment/fund/list/etfinfo/basic/index.shtml?FUNDID=' +
              v[0] +
              '">' +
              v[0] +
              "</a></td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v[7] + "</td>"; //基金扩位简称
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right ' +
              Comparative(v[2], v[6]) +
              '">' +
              v[2].toFixed(3) +
              "</td>"; //当前价
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right ' +
              Comparative(v[2], v[6]) +
              '">' +
              v[3].toFixed(2) +
              "%</td>"; //涨跌幅
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' +
              (v[5] / 10000).toFixed(2) +
              "</td>"; //成交额
            htm += "</tr>";
          });
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_etfQuotes .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_etfQuotes .table").html(htm);
      },
    });
  },
};
if ($(".js_etfQuotes").length > 0) {
  etfQuotes.init();
}
//ETF专栏首页 end

  init: function () {
    this.fundCode = getWindowHref().FUNDID; //获取基金代码参数

  loadEvents: function () {
    //事件绑定
    var _this = this;
    if ($(".js_transactionOverview").length > 0) {
      //日期初始化--成交概况
      $(".js_transactionOverview .sse_input").attr("placeholder", "查询日期");
      var paramsHtml = '<div class="product_sel">';
      paramsHtml += '<div class="js_dateType">周期：';
      paramsHtml += '<span data-value="day" class="active">每日</span>';
      paramsHtml += '<span data-value="month">月度</span>';
      paramsHtml += '<span data-value="year">年度</span>';
      paramsHtml += "</div>";
      paramsHtml += "</div>";
      $(".js_transactionOverview .pro_inputBox").append(paramsHtml);
      $(".js_transactionOverview .sse_colContent").on(
        "click",
        "span",
        function () {
          var index = $(this).index();
          $(this).siblings("span").removeClass("active");
          $(this).addClass("active");
          _this.typeNum = index;
          var typeArr = ["date", "month", "year"];
          $(".js_transactionOverview .js_dateRange").html("");
          $(".js_transactionOverview .js_dateRange").append(
            '<div class="sse_searchInput"><input class="form-control sse_input" type="text" placeholder="查询日期" readonly><span class="bi-calendar4-week"></span></div>'
          );

          var inputVal = _this.searchDay;
          if (index == 1) {
            var temp = _this.searchDay.substring(5, 7) - 1;
            if (temp < 10) {
              temp = "0" + temp;
            }
            inputVal = _this.searchDay.substring(0, 5) + temp;
          } else if (index == 2) {
            inputVal = _this.searchDay.substring(0, 4) - 1;
          }
          laydate({
            elem: ".js_transactionOverview .js_dateRange input",
            theme: "#b50005",
            format: "yyyy-MM-dd",
            min: "1990-12-19",
            max: _this.todayDate,
            type: typeArr[index],
            value: inputVal,
            trigger: "click",
            btns: ["confirm"],
            done: function (value, date, endDate) {
              //选择时间触发查询
              setTimeout(function () {
                _this.isClick = false; //是否点击
                _this.setTransactionParanmByCDate();
              }, 500);
            },
          });
          _this.isClick = true;
          _this.setTransactionParanmByCDate(inputVal);
        }
      );
      laydate({
        elem: ".js_transactionOverview .js_dateRange input",
        theme: "#b50005",
        format: "yyyy-MM-dd",
        min: "1990-12-19",
        max: _this.todayDate,
        trigger: "click",
        btns: ["confirm"],
        done: function (value, date, endDate) {
          //选择时间触发查询
          setTimeout(function () {
            _this.setTransactionParanm();
          }, 500);
        },
      });
    }
    //日期初始化--基金规模
    $(".js_fundSize .sse_input").attr("placeholder", "查询日期");
    laydate({
      elem: ".js_fundSize .js_dateRange input",
      theme: "#b50005",
      format: "yyyy-MM-dd",
      min: "1990-12-19",
      max: _this.todayDate,
      trigger: "click",
      btns: ["confirm"],
      done: function (value, date, endDate) {
        //选择时间触发查询
        setTimeout(function () {
          _this.setFundSizeParam(1);
        }, 500);
      },
    });
    //日期初始化--投资组合
    $(".js_fundPortfolio .sse_input").attr("placeholder", "查询日期");
    laydate({
      elem: ".js_fundPortfolio .js_dateRange input",
      theme: "#b50005",
      format: "yyyy-MM-dd",
      min: "1990-12-19",
      max: _this.todayDate,
      trigger: "click",
      btns: ["confirm"],
      done: function (value, date, endDate) {
        //选择时间触发查询
        setTimeout(function () {
          _this.setPortfolioParam(1);
        }, 500);
      },
    });
    //代码输入框点击
    $(".productDetail_nav .search_btn").on("click", function () {
      _this.initFuntion();
    });
    //代码输入框点击回车键触发查询
    $("#inputCode").on(bind_name, function (e) {
      var keyCode = e.keyCode || e.which || e.charCode;
      if (keyCode == 13) {
        _this.initFuntion();
      }
    });
    //基金规模 -- 注
    $(".js_fundSize .sse_colContent").append(
      "<div class='remarks'><span>注：统计数据为当日清算后数据</span></div>"
    );
    $(".js_fundPerson .title_lev1").append("<span class='new_date'></span>");
    //初始化需要隐藏的模块(有数据才展示)
    $(".js_fundSize").hide(); //基金规模
    $(".js_subscription").parent().hide(); //公告申购赎回清单
    $(".js_subscription").hide(); //申购赎回清单
    $(".js_beforeSubscription").hide(); //日内容信息
    $(".js_nowSubscription").hide(); //日内容信息
    $(".js_constituentStocks").hide(); //成份股信息内容
    $(".js_fundStart").hide(); //基金发起人
    $(".js_fundPerson").hide(); //基金持有人结构
    $(".js_netWorth").hide(); //基金净值
    $(".js_fundShare").hide(); //历年分红
    $(".js_reitsFundShare").hide(); //reits历年分红
    $(".js_searchHistory").parent().hide(); //投资组合
    $(".js_searchHistory").hide(); //基金历史行情查询
    $(".js_tenStock").hide(); //该基金投资的十大股票
    $(".js_categoryTopTen").hide(); //基金持股所属行业分类前十名
  },
  //初始化页面
  initFuntion: function (isFirst) {
    var _this = fundDetails;
    //一级标题无日期标签需拼接
    $(".js_marketIndex .title_lev1").append('<span class="new_date"></span>');
    $(".js_marketIndex").hide();

    if (!isFirst) {
      var inputCode = $("#inputCode").val() ? $("#inputCode").val() : ""; //证券代码
      if (!inputCode) {
        return false;
      }
      if (inputCode && (inputCode.length != 6 || isNaN(inputCode))) {
        bootstrapModal({
          text: "证券代码必须为6位数字",
        });
        return false;
      }
      _this.fundCode = inputCode;
    }
    if (!_this.fundCode) {
      return;
    }
    if ($(".js_reits").length > 0) {
      //reits
      _this.reitShareParam.fundCode = _this.fundCode;
      _this.resitAnnouceParam.fundCode = _this.fundCode;
      _this.resitOverViewParam.fundCode = _this.fundCode;
      _this.reitesFundOverview(); //基金概况
      _this.getReitsShare(); //reits分红
      //reits公告
      var moreUrl =
        '<a href="/disclosure/fund/announcement/"  target="_blank" class="bi-arrow-right-circle"></a>'; //更多--最新公告
      $(".js_reitsAnnouncement .title_lev1").append(moreUrl);
      _this.setReitsAannounceParams();
    } else {
      _this.overviewParam.fundCode = _this.fundCode;
      _this.getFundOverview();
      //相关公告
      var moreUrl =
        '<a href="/disclosure/fund/announcement/"  target="_blank" class="bi-arrow-right-circle"></a>'; //更多--最新公告
      $(".js_announcement .title_lev1").append(moreUrl);
      _this.announcementParams.SECURITY_CODE = _this.fundCode;
      _this.setAnnouncementParams();
    }
    if (
      $(".js_etfCom").length > 0 ||
      $(".js_buyly").length > 0 ||
      $(".js_close").length > 0
    ) {
      _this.setTransactionParanm(); //成交概况
    }
    if ($(".js_etfCom").length > 0) {
      // 历史链接
      $("<div/>", {
        class: "his_remarks",
      }).appendTo(".js_transactionOverview");
      var his_remarks =
        "<a href='/assortment/fund/list/etfinfo/turnover/index.shtml?FUNDID=" +
        _this.fundCode +
        "'style='font-size:12px;font-weight:normal;float:inherit;color:#bc0007;' target='_blank'>更多历史数据，请点击此处</a>";
      $(".his_remarks").html(his_remarks);
    }
    if ($(".js_buyly").length > 0) {
      // 历史链接
      $("<div/>", {
        class: "his_remarks",
      }).appendTo(".js_transactionOverview");
      var his_remarks =
        "<a href='/assortment/fund/list/tcurrencyfundinfo/turnover/index.shtml?FUNDID=" +
        _this.fundCode +
        "'&IS_NOT_DB=-&TYPE=y style='font-size:12px;font-weight:normal;float:inherit;color:#bc0007;' target='_blank'>更多历史数据，请点击此处</a>";
      $(".his_remarks").html(his_remarks);
    }

    if ($(".js_etfCom").length > 0 || $(".js_buyly").length > 0) {
      _this.setFundSizeParam(); //基金规模
      //申购赎回清单
      _this.subscriptionParam.FUNDID2 = _this.fundCode;
      _this.getSubscription();
      //成份股信息内容
      _this.constituentParam.FUNDID2 = _this.fundCode;
      _this.getConstituentStocks(1);
    }
    if ($(".js_close").length > 0) {
      _this.searchHistoryParam.FUNDID = _this.fundCode;
      _this.tenStockParam.FUNDID = _this.fundCode;
      _this.topTenParam.FUNDID = _this.fundCode;
      _this.fundStartParam.FUNDID = _this.fundCode;
      _this.fundPersonParam.FUNDID = _this.fundCode;
      _this.shareParam.FUNDID = _this.fundCode;
      _this.fundWorthParam.FUNDID = _this.fundCode;

      _this.getFundStart(); //基金发起人
      _this.getFundPerson(); //基金持有人结构
      _this.getSearchHistory(); //基金历史行情查询
      _this.getTenStock(); //该基金投资的十大股票
      _this.getCategoryTopTen(); //基金持股所属行业分类前十名
      _this.getShare(); //历年分红
      _this.getFundNetWorth();
    }
    //获取行情走势
    $("#priceCharts").html(
      '<div class="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center noChart_message" style="height:300px;">暂无走势信息</div>'
    );
    _this.getMarketIndex(); //行情
  },
  //获取行情指标
  getMarketIndex: function () {
    var _this = this,
      marketIndexHtml = "";
    $.ajax({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.marketIndexUrl + _this.fundCode,
      data: _this.marketIndexParams,
      jsonp: "callback",
      success: function (resulatData) {
        if (resulatData && resulatData.snap) {
          var data = resulatData.snap,
            dataDate = resulatData.date + "",
            dataTime = resulatData.time + "";
          dataDate = dataDate ? turnDateAddLine(dataDate) : "";
          dataTime = dataTime.length == 5 ? "0" + dataTime : dataTime;
          dataTime = dataTime
            ? dataTime.substring(0, 2) +
            ":" +
            dataTime.substring(2, 4) +
            ":" +
            dataTime.substring(4, 6)
            : "";
          $(".js_marketIndex .new_date").html(dataDate + " " + dataTime);
          var _last = data[1].toFixed(3), //最新
            _lastColor = Comparative(data[1], data[7]), //最新
            _chg_rate = data[2].toFixed(2), //涨跌幅
            _chg_rateColor = Comparative(data[2], 0), //涨跌幅
            _change = data[3].toFixed(3), //涨跌
            _changeColor = Comparative(data[2], 0), //涨跌
            _amount = (data[4] / 10000).toFixed(2), //成交金额
            _volume = (data[5] / 100).toFixed(0), //成交量
            _prev_close = _last != 0 ? data[7].toFixed(3) : data[7].toFixed(2), //昨收
            _high = data[10].toFixed(3), //最高
            _highColor = Comparative(data[10], data[7]), //最高
            _low = data[11].toFixed(3), //最低
            _lowColor = Comparative(data[11], data[7]), //最低,
            _fp_volume = (data[13] / 100).toFixed(0), //盘后成交量
            _fp_amount = (data[14] / 10000).toFixed(2), //盘后成交额
            _fp_phaseArr = data[15] ? data[15].split("") : [];  //盘后交易状态
            _cpxxsubtype = data[16];  //证券产品子类型
          //停牌
          var _tradephase = data[12];
          var isP1 = _tradephase.replace(/\s/gi, "") == "P1";

          marketIndexHtml += '<table class="table"><tbody><tr>';
          marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最新</td>';
          marketIndexHtml +=
            '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">涨跌幅</td>';
          marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最高</td>';
          marketIndexHtml +=
            '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">成交量(手)</td>';
          if (_cpxxsubtype === "EBS") {
            marketIndexHtml +=
              '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">盘后成交量(手)</td>';
            marketIndexHtml +=
              '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">交易状态</td>';
          }
          marketIndexHtml += "</tr><tr>";
          marketIndexHtml +=
            '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap ' +
            (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _lastColor : "") +
            '">' +
            (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _last : !isP1 ? "暂无成交" : "停牌") +
            "</td>"; //最新
          marketIndexHtml +=
            '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap ' +
            (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _chg_rateColor : "") +
            '">' +
            (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _chg_rate + "%" : "--") +
            "</td>"; //涨跌幅
          marketIndexHtml +=
            '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap ' +
            (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _highColor : "") +
            '">' +
            (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _high : "--") +
            "</td>"; //最高
          marketIndexHtml +=
            '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">' +
            (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _volume : "--") +
            "</td>"; //成交量
          if (_cpxxsubtype === "EBS") {
            marketIndexHtml +=
              '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">' +
              (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _fp_volume : "--") +
              "</td>"; //盘后成交量
            marketIndexHtml +=
              '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">' +
              getTradephaseText(_tradephase) +
              "</td>"; //交易状态
          }
          marketIndexHtml += "</tr>";

          marketIndexHtml += '<tr><td colspan="6"><hr></td></tr>';

          marketIndexHtml += "<tr>";
          marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">前收</td>';
          marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">涨跌</td>';
          marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最低</td>';
          marketIndexHtml +=
            '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">成交金额(万元)</td>';
          if (_cpxxsubtype === "EBS") {
            marketIndexHtml +=
              '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">盘后成交金额(万元)</td>';
            marketIndexHtml +=
              '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">盘后交易状态</td>';
          }
          marketIndexHtml += "</tr><tr>";
          marketIndexHtml +=
            '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">' +
            (!isP1 ? _prev_close : "--") +
            "</td>"; //昨收
          marketIndexHtml +=
            '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap ' +
            (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _changeColor : "") +
            '">' +
            (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _change : "--") +
            "</td>"; //涨跌
          marketIndexHtml +=
            '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap ' +
            (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _lowColor : "") +
            '">' +
            (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _low : "--") +
            "</td>"; //最低
          marketIndexHtml +=
            '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">' +
            (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _amount : "--") +
            "</td>"; //成交金额
          if (_cpxxsubtype === "EBS") {
            marketIndexHtml +=
              '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">' +
              (_last != 0 && !isP1 ? _fp_amount : "--") +
              "</td>"; //盘后成交金额
            marketIndexHtml +=
              '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">' +
              getFpphaseText(_fp_phaseArr) +
              "</td>"; //盘后交易状态
          }
          marketIndexHtml += "</tr></tbody></table>";
          $(".js_marketIndex .table-responsive").html(marketIndexHtml);
          if (data.length > 0) {
            $(".js_marketIndex").show();
          }
          require(["highstock"], function () {
            if (_cpxxsubtype === "EBS") {
              drawOneDayChart(_this.fundCode, "priceCharts", "", true, "etf");
            } else {
              drawOneDayChart(_this.fundCode, "priceCharts", "", true, "fund");
            }
          });
        } else {
          $(".js_marketIndex .new_date").html("");
          marketIndexHtml += _this.getMarketIndexNull();
          $(".js_marketIndex .table-responsive").html(marketIndexHtml);
        }
      },
      error: function () {
        $(".js_marketIndex .new_date").html("");
        marketIndexHtml += _this.getMarketIndexNull();
        $(".js_marketIndex .table-responsive").html(marketIndexHtml);
      },
    });
  },
  //行情指标为空
  getMarketIndexNull: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var marketIndexHtml = '<table class="table"><tbody><tr>';
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最新</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">涨跌幅</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最高</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">成交量(手)</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += "</tr><tr>";
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">-</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">-</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">-</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">-</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += "</tr>";
    marketIndexHtml += '<tr><td colspan="5"><hr></td></tr>';
    marketIndexHtml += "<tr>";
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">昨收</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">涨跌幅</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最低</td>';
    marketIndexHtml +=
      '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">成交金额(万元)</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += "</tr><tr>";
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">-</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">-</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">-</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += '<td class="colData_val text-nowrap">-</td>';
    marketIndexHtml += "</tr></tbody></table>";
    return marketIndexHtml;
  },
  //成交概况赋值参数
  setTransactionParanm: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var timeStr = $(".js_transactionOverview .sse_input").val();
    time = timeStr ? timeStr : _this.searchDay; //初始化时间是空取默认时间
    var iny = "",
      searchYear = "",
      inMonth = "", //年，参数年，月
      iny = Number(time.substring(0, 4));
    searchYear = timeStr
      ? Number(time.substring(0, 4))
      : Number(time.substring(0, 4)) - 1; //初始化年参数取上一年的
    inMonth = timeStr
      ? Number(time.substring(5, 7))
      : Number(time.substring(5, 7)) - 1; //初始化月份取上一月的
    if (inMonth == 0) {
      inMonth = 12;
      iny--;
    }
    if (inMonth <= 9) {
      inMonth = "0" + inMonth;
    }
    _this.transactionParam.SEC_CODE = _this.fundCode;
    $(".js_transactionOverview .js_dateRange .sse_input").val(time);
    $(".js_transactionOverview .new_date").html(time);
    var timeSpan = time.replace("-", "年").replace("-", "月") + "日";
    if (_this.typeNum == 0) {
      _this.transactionParam.TX_DATE = time;
    } else if (_this.typeNum == 1) {
      timeSpan = iny + "年" + inMonth + "月";
      _this.transactionParam.TX_DATE_MON = iny + "" + inMonth;
    } else if (_this.typeNum == 2) {
      _this.transactionParam.TX_DATE_YEAR = searchYear;
      timeSpan = searchYear + "年";
    }
    $(".js_transactionOverview .title_lev1 .new_date").html(timeSpan);
    _this.getTransaction();
  },
  // // 默认取最大日期数据点击事件
  defaultNull: function () {
    var _this = this;
    _this.transactionParam.TX_DATE_MON = "";
    _this.transactionParam.TX_DATE_YEAR = "";
    _this.transactionParam.TX_DATE = "";
  },
  //成交概况点击切换赋值参数
  setTransactionParanmByCDate: function (timeVal) {
    var _this = this;
    var timeStr = $(".js_transactionOverview .sse_input").val();
    timeStr = timeStr ? timeStr : timeVal;
    _this.defaultNull();
    if (_this.typeNum == 0) {
      _this.transactionParam.TX_DATE = _this.isClick == false ? timeStr : "";
      _this.transactionParam["sqlId"] =
        "COMMON_SSE_CP_GPJCTPZ_GPLB_CJGK_MRGK_C";
      var timeSpan = time.replace("-", "年").replace("-", "月") + "日";
      $(".js_transactionOverview .title_lev1 .new_date").html(timeSpan);
    } else if (_this.typeNum == 1) {
      _this.transactionParam.TX_DATE_MON =
        _this.isClick == false ? timeStr.replace(/\-/g, "") : "";
      _this.transactionParam["sqlId"] =
        "COMMON_SSE_CP_GPJCTPZ_GPLB_CJGK_YDGK_C";
      var timeSpan = time.replace("-", "年").replace("-", "月");
      $(".js_transactionOverview .title_lev1 .new_date").html(timeSpan);
    } else if (_this.typeNum == 2) {
      _this.transactionParam.TX_DATE_YEAR =
        _this.isClick == false ? timeStr : "";
      _this.transactionParam["sqlId"] =
        "COMMON_SSE_CP_GPJCTPZ_GPLB_CJGK_NDGK_C";
      var timeSpan = time.replace("-", "年");
      $(".js_transactionOverview .title_lev1 .new_date").html(timeSpan);
    }
    _this.getTransaction();
  },
  //成交概况 isfrist默认首次访问
  getTransaction: function () {
    var _this = this;
    if (homeFundList.isfrist) {
      // 每日首次访问
      _this.transactionParam.TX_DATE_MON = "";
      _this.transactionParam.TX_DATE_YEAR = "";

    empty += "<tr>";
    empty += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';

    empty += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty += "</tr>";

    empty += "<tr>";

    empty += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap"></td>';
    empty += "</tr>";
    empty += "<tr>";
    empty += '<td class="colData_val text-right"></td>';
    empty += '<td class="colData_val text-right"></td>';
    empty += "</tr>";

    var htm = "<tbody>";
    //为空Html
    empty1 = "<tr>";
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">市价总值（万元）</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">流通市值（万元）</td>';

    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">成交金额（万元）</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">流通股换手率（%）</td>';

    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty1 += "</tr>";
    empty1 += '<tr><td colspan="5"><hr></td></tr>';
    empty1 += "<tr>";

    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">累计交易日</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最高成价（元）</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最低成价（元）</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最高成交量（万份）</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最低成交量（万份）</td>';
    empty1 += "</tr>";
    empty1 += "<tr>";
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty1 += "</tr>";
    empty1 += '<tr><td colspan="5"><hr></td></tr>';
    empty1 += "<tr>";

    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最高成交金额（万元）</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最低成交金额（万元）</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap"></td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap"></td>';
    empty1 += "</tr>";
    empty1 += "<tr>";
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right">-</td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right"></td>';
    empty1 += '<td class="colData_val text-right"></td>';
    empty1 += "</tr>";
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.transactionUrl,
      data: _this.transactionParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          var defaultObj = {
            TOTAL_VALUE: "-",
            NEGO_VALUE: "-",
            TRADE_VOL: "-",
            TRADE_AMT: "-",
            NEGO_VALUE: "-",
            ACCU_TRADE_DAYS: "",
            HIGH_PRICE: "-",
            HIGH_PRICE_DATE: "",
            LOW_PRICE: "-",
            LOW_PRICE_DATE: "",
            HIGH_VOL: "-",
            HIGH_VOL_DATE: "",
            LOW_VOL: "-",
            LOW_VOL_DATE: "",
            HIGH_AMT: "-",
            HIGH_AMT_DATE: "",
            LOW_AMT: "-",
            LOW_AMT_DATE: "",
            TO_RATE: "",
          };
          function filtersArrDate(item) {
            if (_this.typeNum == 0) {
              return item.DATE_TYPE == "D"; // 日
            } else if (_this.typeNum == 1) {
              return item.DATE_TYPE == "M"; // 月
            } else if (_this.typeNum == 2) {
              return item.DATE_TYPE == "Y"; // 年
            }
          }

          var dataObj = data.result.filter(filtersArrDate);
          if (Array.isArray(dataObj) && dataObj.length == 0) {
            dataObj = [defaultObj];
          }

          htm += "<tr>";
          htm += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">市价总值（万元）</td>';

          htm +=

            htm += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最高成价（元）</td>';
            htm += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最低成价（元）</td>';
            htm +=
              '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最高成交量（万份）</td>';
            htm +=
              '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最低成交量（万份）</td>';

            htm += "</tr>";
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="colData_val text-right">' +
              dataObj[0].ACCU_TRADE_DAYS +
              "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="colData_val text-right">' +
              dataObj[0].HIGH_PRICE +
              "<br/>" +
              dateReplace(dataObj[0].HIGH_PRICE, dataObj[0].HIGH_PRICE_DATE) +
              "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="colData_val text-right">' +
              dataObj[0].LOW_PRICE +
              "<br/>" +
              dateReplace(dataObj[0].LOW_PRICE, dataObj[0].LOW_PRICE_DATE) +
              "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="colData_val text-right">' +
              dataObj[0].HIGH_VOL +
              "<br/>" +
              dateReplace(dataObj[0].HIGH_VOL, dataObj[0].HIGH_VOL_DATE) +
              "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="colData_val text-right">' +
              dataObj[0].LOW_VOL +
              "<br/>" +
              dateReplace(dataObj[0].LOW_VOL, dataObj[0].LOW_VOL_DATE) +
              "</td>";
            htm += "</tr>";
            htm += '<tr><td colspan="5"><hr></td></tr>';
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最高成交金额（万元）</td>';
            htm +=
              '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最低成交金额（万元）</td>';
            htm += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap"></td>';
            htm += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap"></td>';
            htm += "</tr>";
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="colData_val text-right">' +
              dataObj[0].HIGH_AMT +
              "<br/>" +
              dateReplace(dataObj[0].HIGH_AMT, dataObj[0].HIGH_AMT_DATE) +
              "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="colData_val text-right">' +
              dataObj[0].LOW_AMT +
              "<br/>" +
              dateReplace(dataObj[0].LOW_AMT, dataObj[0].LOW_AMT_DATE) +
              "</td>";
            htm += '<td class="colData_val text-right"></td>';
            htm += '<td class="colData_val text-right"></td>';
            htm += '<td class="colData_val text-right"></td>';
            htm += "</tr>";
          } else {
            htm += '<tr><td colspan="5"><hr></td></tr>';
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最高成价（元）</td>';
            htm += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap">最低成价（元）</td>';

              "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="colData_val text-right">' +
              dataObj[0].LOW_PRICE +
              "<br/>" +
              dateReplace(dataObj[0].LOW_PRICE, dataObj[0].LOW_PRICE_DATE) +
              "</td>";
            htm += "</tr>";
            htm += '<tr><td colspan="5"><hr></td></tr>';
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap"></td>';
            htm += '<td class="colData_title text-nowrap"></td>';
            htm += "</tr>";
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm += "</tr>";
          }
        } else {
          if (_this.typeNum == 0) {
            htm += empty;
          } else {
            htm += empty1;
          }
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_transactionOverview .table").html(htm);
        // 日期类型
        var timevalue = $(".js_transactionOverview .js_dateType .active").attr(
          "data-value"
        );
        // 传值日期控件
        var timeipt = $(".js_transactionOverview .sse_input");
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length) {
          if (timevalue == "year") {
            timeipt.val(data.result[0].TX_DATE.substr(0, 4));
          } else if (timevalue == "month") {
            timeipt.val(
              data.result[0].TX_DATE.substr(0, 6).replace(
                /^(\d{4})(\d{2})$/,
                "$1-$2"
              )
            );
          } else if (timevalue == "day") {
            timeipt.val(
              data.result[0].TX_DATE.substr(0, 8).replace(
                /^(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})$/,
                "$1-$2-$3"
              )
            );
          }
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += empty;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_transactionOverview .table").html(htm);
      },
    });
  },
  //设置基金规模参数
  setFundSizeParam: function (isDate) {
    var _this = this;
    if (!isDate) {
      _this.fundSizeParam = {
        isPagination: true,
        sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_ZQPZ_ETFZL_ETFJBXX_JJGM_MOREN_L",
        SEC_CODE: _this.fundCode,
        "pageHelp.pageSize": 10,
      };
    } else {
      var dateStr = $(".js_fundSize .sse_input").val();
      _this.fundSizeParam = {
        isPagination: false,
        sqlId: "COMMON_SSE_ZQPZ_ETFZL_ETFJBXX_JJGM_SEARCH_L",
        SEC_CODE: _this.fundCode,
        STAT_DATE: dateStr,
      };
    }
    _this.getFundSize();
  },
  //基金规模
  getFundSize: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var htm =
      '<thead><tr><th>日期</th><th>基金代码</th><th>基金扩位简称</th><th class="text-right">总份额（万份）</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="18">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.fundSizeParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $(".js_fundSize").show();
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.STAT_DATE + "</td>"; //日期
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.SEC_CODE + "</td>"; //基金代码
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.FUND_EXPANSION_ABBR + "</td>"; //基金简称
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + v.TOT_VOL + "</td>"; //总份额（万份）
            htm += "</tr>";
          });
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_fundSize .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_fundSize .table").html(htm);
      },
    });
  },
  /**
   * 申赎模式字段处理
   */
  creationRedemptionEscape: function(mechanism) {
    let mechanismName = '';
    switch(mechanism) {
      case '0':
        mechanismName = '现金申赎';
        break;
      case '1':
        mechanismName = '沪市成分证券实物对价';
        break;
      case '2':
        mechanismName = '沪市、深市成分证券实物对价';
        break;
      case '3':
        mechanismName = '银行间市场债券实物对价';
        break;
      default: 
        mechanismName = '-';
    }
    return mechanismName;
  },
  //申购赎回清单基本信息
  getSubscription: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="18">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    var htm = "<tbody>"; //申购赎回清单
    var htm01 = "<tbody>"; //日内容信息
    var htm02 = "<tbody>"; //日内容信息

    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.subscriptionParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        var beforeDate = "",
          thisDate = "";
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $(".js_subscription").parent().show();
          $(".js_subscription").show();
          $(".js_nowSubscription").show();
          $(".js_beforeSubscription").show();
          var dataObj = data.result;
          $(".js_subscription").prepend(
            '<a class="tableDownload js_download-export" href="' +
            _this.downHref +
            dataObj[0].TRADE_CODE +
            '">下载</a>'
          );
          htm +=
            "<tr><td>最新公告日期</td><td>" +
            turnDateAddLine(dataObj[0].TRADING_DAY) +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm +=
            "<tr><td>基金名称</td><td>" + dataObj[0].FUND_NAME + "</td></tr>";
          htm +=
            "<tr><td>基金管理公司名称</td><td>" +
            dataObj[0].FUND_COMP_NAME +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm +=
            "<tr><td>基金代码</td><td>" +
            dataObj[0].TRADE_CODE +
            "</td></tr>";

          htm01 +=
            "<tr><td>现金差额(单位:元)</td><td>" +
            dataObj[0].PRE_CASH_COMPONENT +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm01 +=
            "<tr><td>最小申购、赎回单位净值(单位：元)</td><td>" +
            dataObj[0].NAVPERCU +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm01 +=
            "<tr><td>基金份额净值(单位:元)</td><td>" +
            dataObj[0].NAV +
            "</td></tr>";

          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>最小申购、赎回单位的预估现金部分(单位:元)</td><td>" +
            dataObj[0].ESTIMATED_CASH_COMPONENT +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>现金替代比例上限</td><td>" +
            dataObj[0].MAX_CASH_RATIO +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>当日累计可申购的基金份额上限</td><td>" +
            (dataObj[0].CREATION_LIMIT == 0 ? '-' : dataObj[0].CREATION_LIMIT) +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>当日累计可赎回的基金份额上限</td><td>" +
            (dataObj[0].REDEMPTION_LIMIT == 0 ? '-' : dataObj[0].REDEMPTION_LIMIT) +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>当日净申购的基金份额上限</td><td>" +
            (dataObj[0].NET_CREATION_LIMIT == 0 ? '-' : dataObj[0].NET_CREATION_LIMIT) +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>当日净赎回的基金份额上限</td><td>" +
            (dataObj[0].NET_REDEMPTION_LIMIT == 0 ? '-' : dataObj[0].NET_REDEMPTION_LIMIT) +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>单个证券账户当日净申购的基金份额上限</td><td>" +
            (dataObj[0].NET_CREATION_LIMIT_PER_ACCT == 0 ? '-' : dataObj[0].NET_CREATION_LIMIT_PER_ACCT) +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>单个证券账户当日净赎回的基金份额上限</td><td>" +
            (dataObj[0].NET_REDEMPTION_LIMIT_PER_ACCT == 0 ? '-' : dataObj[0].NET_REDEMPTION_LIMIT_PER_ACCT) +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>单个证券账户当日累计可申购的基金份额上限</td><td>" +
            (dataObj[0].CREATION_LIMIT_PER_ACCT == 0 ? '-' : dataObj[0].CREATION_LIMIT_PER_ACCT) +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>单个证券账户当日累计可赎回的基金份额上限</td><td>" +
            (dataObj[0].REDEMPTION_LIMIT_PER_ACCT == 0 ? '-' : dataObj[0].REDEMPTION_LIMIT_PER_ACCT) +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>是否需要公布IOPV</td><td>" +
            dataObj[0].PUBLISH_IOPV +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>最小申购、赎回单位(单位:份)</td><td>" +
            dataObj[0].CREATION_REDEMPTION_UNIT +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>申购赎回的允许情况</td><td>" +
            dataObj[0].CREATION_REDEMPTION +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm02 +=
            "<tr><td>申购赎回模式</td><td>" +
            _this.creationRedemptionEscape(dataObj[0].CREATION_REDEMPTION_MECHANISM) + 
            "</td></tr>";
          beforeDate = turnDateAddLine(dataObj[0].PRE_TRADING_DAY);
          thisDate = turnDateAddLine(dataObj[0].TRADING_DAY);
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
          htm01 += emptyTr;
          htm02 += emptyTr;
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        htm01 += "</tbody>";
        htm02 += "</tbody>";

        $(".js_beforeSubscription .title_lev2").html(beforeDate + "日内容信息");
        $(".js_nowSubscription .title_lev2").html(thisDate + "日内容信息");
        $(".js_subscription .table").html(htm);
        $(".js_beforeSubscription .table").html(htm01);
        $(".js_nowSubscription .table").html(htm02);
      },
    });
  },
  /**
   * 现金替代标识字段处理
   */
  substitutionEscape: function(flag, etfVersion) {
    let substitutionName = '';
    if (etfVersion === 'XML') {
      switch (flag) {
        case '0':
          substitutionName = '禁止';
          break;
        case '1':
          substitutionName = '允许';
          break;
        case '2':
          substitutionName = '必须';
          break;
        default: 
          substitutionName = '无';
      }
    } else {
      switch (flag) {
        case '0':
          substitutionName = '禁止';
          break;
        case '1':
          substitutionName = '允许';
          break;
        case '2':
          substitutionName = '必须';
          break;
        case '3':
          substitutionName = '深市或京市退补';
          break;
        case '4':
          substitutionName = '深市或京市必须';
          break;
        case '5':
          substitutionName = '退补';
          break;
        case '6':
          substitutionName = '必须';
          break;
        case '7':
          substitutionName = '港市退补';
          break;
        case '8':
          substitutionName = '港市必须';
          break;
        default: 
          substitutionName = '无';
      }
    }
    return substitutionName;
  },
  /**
   * 挂牌市场字段处理
   */
  marketEscape: function(market) {
    let marketName = '';
    switch (market) {
      case '101':
        marketName = '上海证券交易所';
        break;
      case '102':
        marketName = '深圳证券交易所';
        break;
      case '103':
        marketName = '香港联合交易所';
        break;
      case '105':
        marketName = '外汇交易中心';
        break;
      case '106':
        marketName = '北京证券交易所';
        break;
      case '9999':
        marketName = '其他';
        break;
      default:
        marketName = '-';
    }
    return marketName;
  },
  //成份股信息内容
  getConstituentStocks: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (
      !paginationChange(
        _this.constituentParam,
        pageIndex,
        ".js_constituentStocks"
      )
    )
      return; //触发分页改变分页参数
    _this.constituentParam["pageHelp.pageSize"] = 10;
    var htm = "<thead>";
    htm += "<tr>";
    htm += '<th class="codeNameWidth"><span>证券代码</span></th>';
    htm += '<th class="codeNameWidth"><span>证券简称</span></th>';

    var htm01 = "<th>现金替代标志</th>";
    htm01 += '<th class="text-right">申购现金<br>替代溢价比率</th>';
    htm01 += '<th class="text-right">赎回现金<br>替代折价比率</th>';
    htm01 +=
      '<th class="text-right">替代金额<br>(单位：人民币元)</th>';
    htm01 += '<th class="text-right">挂牌市场</th></tr></thead><tbody>';

    var htm02 = "<th>现金替代标志</th>";
    htm02 += '<th class="text-right">现金替代溢价比率</th>';
    htm02 +=
      '<th class="text-right">替代金额<br>(单位：人民币元)</th>';
    htm02 += '<th class="text-right">挂牌市场</th></tr></thead><tbody>';

    var trHtm = "<th></th>";

    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="18">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.constituentParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $(".js_constituentStocks").parent().show();
          $(".js_constituentStocks").show();
          var etfType;
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            if (k == 0) {
              etfType =
                v.ETF_VERSION && v.ETF_VERSION != "-" ? v.ETF_VERSION : "2.0";
              if (v.ETF_CLASS && v.ETF_CLASS != "-") {
                var etf_class = v.ETF_CLASS;
                if (
                  etf_class == "1" ||
                  etf_class == "2" ||
                  etf_class == "3" ||
                  etf_class == "7"
                ) {
                  trHtm = '<th class="text-right">股票数量(股)</th>';
                } else if (etf_class == "4") {
                  trHtm = '<th class="text-right">证券数量(份)</th>';
                }else if (etf_class == "5") {
                  trHtm = '<th class="text-right">证券数量(手)</th>';
                } else if (etf_class == "6") {
                  trHtm = '<th class="text-right">证券数量(克)</th>';
                } else {
                  trHtm = '<th class="text-right">股票数量(股)</th>';
                }
              } else {
                trHtm = '<th class="text-right">股票数量(股)</th>';
              }
              htm += trHtm;
              htm += etfType != "2.0" ? htm01 : htm02;
            }
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' +
              _this.ifNullTurn(v.INSTRUMENT_ID) +
              "</td>"; //证券代码
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' +
              _this.ifNullTurn(v.INSTRUMENT_NAME) +
              "</td>"; //证券简称
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-right">' +
              _this.ifNullTurn(v.QUANTITY) +
              "</td>"; //证券数量
            htm += "<td>" + _this.substitutionEscape(v.SUBSTITUTION_FLAG, v.ETF_VERSION) + "</td>"; //现金替代标志
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-right">' +
              _this.ifNullTurn(v.CREATION_PREMIUM_RATE) +
              "</td>"; //申购现金替代溢价比率
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-right">' +
              _this.ifNullTurn(v.REDEMPTION_DISCOUNT_RATE) +
              "</td>"; //赎回现金替代折价比率
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-right">' +
              (v.SUBSTITUTION_CASH_AMOUNT != null
                ? v.SUBSTITUTION_CASH_AMOUNT
                : "-") +
              "</td>"; //替代金额
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-right">' +
              _this.marketEscape(v.UNDERLYION_SECURITY_ID) +
              "</td>"; //挂牌市场
            htm += "</tr>";
          });
          Page.navigation(
            ".js_constituentStocks .pagination-box",
            data.pageHelp.pageCount,
            data.pageHelp.total,
            data.pageHelp.pageNo,
            data.pageHelp.pageSize,
            "fundDetails.getConstituentStocks"
          );
          $(".js_constituentStocks .pagination-box .change-pageSize").remove();
        } else {
          htm += trHtm;
          htm += htm01;
          htm += emptyTr;
          $(".js_constituentStocks .pagination-box").html("");
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_constituentStocks .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += trHtm;
        htm += htm01;
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_constituentStocks .table").html(htm);
        $(".js_constituentStocks .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
  //基金概况
  getFundOverview: function () {
    var _this = this;
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url:
        _this.overviewParam.sqlId == "FUND_LIST"
          ? _this.commonSoaUrl
          : _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.overviewParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        _this.setOverviewHtm(data.result);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        _this.setOverviewHtm(data.result);
      },
    });
  },
  getFundType: function (fundType, subClass) {
    switch (fundType) {
      case "00":
        if (subClass != "05" && subClass != "07") return "ETF";
        return "货币基金";
        break;
      case "10":
        if (subClass == "12" || subClass == "13") return "分级LOF";
        return "普通LOF";
        break;
      case "40":
        return "封闭式基金";
        break;
      case "30":
        return "实时申赎基金";
        break;
      case "50":
        return "公募REITs";
        break;
    }
  },
  getValue: function (value) {
    if (value != null && value != undefined && value != "") return value;
    return "-";
  },
  //拼接基金概况
  setOverviewHtm: function (fundData) {
    var _this = this;
    var htm = "<tbody>";
    if (fundData && fundData[0] != undefined && fundData.length > 0) {
      htm +=
        '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">基金代码</td><td class="text-nowrap">' +
        _this.getValue(fundData[0].fundCode) +
        "</td></tr>";
      if (fundData[0].fundType != 30) {
        htm +=
          '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">基金扩位简称</td><td class="text-nowrap js_kwjc">' +
          _this.getValue(fundData[0].secNameFull) +
          "</td></tr>";
      }
      //添加END
      htm +=
        '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">基金类别</td><td class="text-nowrap">' +
        _this.getFundType(fundData[0].fundType, fundData[0].subClass) +
        "</td></tr>";
      if (_this.getFundType(fundData[0].fundType, fundData[0].subClass) == "ETF") {
        htm +=
          '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">ETF细分类型</td><td class="text-nowrap">' +
          tab.typeConversion(fundData[0].subClass) +
          "</td></tr>";
      }
      htm +=
        '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">律师事务所</td><td class="text-nowrap">' +
        _this.getValue(fundData[0].LAW_FIRM) +
        "</td></tr>";
      htm +=
        '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">基金管理人</td><td class="text-nowrap"><a href="' +
        _this.downHref01 +
        fundData[0].companyName +
        '" target="_blank">' +
        fundData[0].companyName +
        "</a></td></tr>";
      htm +=
        '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">联系电话</td><td class="text-nowrap">' +
        _this.getValue(fundData[0].CONTACT_MOBILE) +
        "</td></tr>";
      htm +=
        '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">基金托管人</td><td class="text-nowrap">' +
        _this.getValue(fundData[0].TRUSTEE_NAME) +
        "</td></tr>";
      htm +=
        '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">发行价格</td><td class="text-nowrap">-</td></tr>';
      htm +=
        '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">相关指数</td><td class="text-nowrap">' +
        _this.getValue(fundData[0].INDEX_NAME) +
        "</td></tr>";
    } else {
      htm += "<tr><td>基金代码</td><td>-</td></tr>";
      htm += "<tr><td>基金扩位简称</td><td>-</td></tr>";
      htm += "<tr><td>基金类别</td><td>-/-</td></tr>";
      htm += "<tr><td>律师事务所</td><td>-(-)</td></tr>";
      htm += "<tr><td>基金管理人</td><td>-/-</td></tr>";
      htm += "<tr><td>联系电话</td><td>-/-</td></tr>";
      htm += "<tr><td>基金托管人</td><td>-</td></tr>";
      htm += "<tr><td>发行价格</td><td>-(-)</td></tr>";
      htm += "<tr><td>相关指数</td><td>-</td></tr>";
    }
    htm += "</tbody>";
    $(".js_fundOverview .table").html(htm);
    _this.getFundName();
    var allName =
      fundData && fundData.length > 0
        ? fundData[0].fundAbbr
          ? fundData[0].fundAbbr
          : ""
        : "";
    $(".js_page-title").html((allName ? allName : "") + " " + _this.fundCode);
  },

  //获取基金简称
  getFundName: function () {
    var _this = this;
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.fundNameUrl,
      data: {
        secCodes: _this.fundCode,
      },
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          var allName = data.result[0][1] ? data.result[0][1] : "-";
          $(".js_kwjc").html(allName);
          $(".js_page-title").html(
            (allName ? allName : "") + " " + _this.fundCode
          );
        }
      },
    });
  },
  //设置基金公告参数
  setAnnouncementParams: function () {
    var _this = this;
    //日期往前推一年
    _this.announcementParams.START_DATE = changeFormatDate(
      _this.todayDate,
      0,
      0,
      -1
    );
    _this.announcementParams.END_DATE = changeFormatDate(
      _this.todayDate,
      1,
      0,
      0
    );
    //调用接口
    _this.getAnnouncementList(1);
  },
  //获取基金公告
  getAnnouncementList: function (pageIndex) {
    var _this = this;
    if (
      !paginationChange(_this.announcementParams, pageIndex, ".js_announcement")
    )
      return; //触发分页改变分页参数
    _this.announcementParams["pageHelp.pageSize"] = 10;
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.announcementParams,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          var fundAnnouncementHtml = "";
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            fundAnnouncementHtml += '<li class="list-group-item">';
            fundAnnouncementHtml += '<div class="codeTitle">';
            fundAnnouncementHtml +=
              '<span class="companyCode">' +
              (v.SECURITY_CODE && v.SECURITY_CODE != ""
                ? "[" + v.SECURITY_CODE + "]"
                : "") +
              "</span>";
            fundAnnouncementHtml +=
              '<a href="' + v.URL + '" target="_blank">' + v.TITLE + "</a>";
            fundAnnouncementHtml += "</div>";
            fundAnnouncementHtml +=
              '<span class="new_date">' +
              (v.SSEDATE ? v.SSEDATE : "-") +
              "</span>";
            fundAnnouncementHtml += "</li>";
          });
          $(".js_announcement .list-group").html(fundAnnouncementHtml);
          //调用分页
          Page.navigation(
            ".js_announcement .pagination-box",
            data.pageHelp.pageCount,
            data.pageHelp.total,
            data.pageHelp.pageNo,
            data.pageHelp.pageSize,
            "fundDetails.getAnnouncementList"
          );
          $(".js_announcement .change-pageSize").remove();
        } else {
          $(".js_announcement .list-group").html(
            '<li class="list-group-item">暂无数据</li>'
          );
          $(".js_announcement .pagination-box").html("");
        }
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        $(".js_announcement .list-group").html(
          '<li class="list-group-item">暂无数据</li>'
        );
        $(".js_announcement .pagination-box").html("");
      },
    });
  },
