  //投资组合--基金历史行情查询
  getSearchHistory: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var htm = "<tbody>";
    var emptyTr =
      '<tr><td>持有现金与持有国债<br/>市值合计(万元)</td><td class="text-right">-</td></tr>';
    emptyTr +=
      '<tr><td>持有股票市值(万元)</td><td class="text-right">-</td></tr>';
    emptyTr += '<tr><td>其他(万元)</td><td class="text-right">-</td></tr>';
    emptyTr +=
      '<tr><td>基金资产净值(万元)</td><td class="text-right">-</td></tr>';

    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.searchHistoryParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $(".js_searchHistory").parent().show();
          $(".js_searchHistory").show();
          htm += "<tr>";
          htm += "<td>持有现金与持有国债<br/>市值合计(万元)</td>";
          htm +=
            '<td class="text-right">' +
            _this.stringFormatter(data.result[0].DEBT_VALUE) +
            "</td></tr>";
          htm += "<tr>";

          htm += "<td>持有股票市值(万元)</td>";
          htm +=
            '<td class="text-right">' +
            _this.stringFormatter(data.result[0].STOCK_VALUE) +
            "</td>";
          htm += "</tr>";

          htm += "<td>其他(万元)</td>";
          htm +=
            '<td class="text-right">' +
            _this.stringFormatter(data.result[0].OTHER_VALUE) +
            "</td>";
          htm += "</tr>";

          htm += "<tr>";
          htm += "<td>基金资产净值(万元)</td>";
          htm +=
            '<td class="text-right">' +
            _this.stringFormatter(data.result[0].FUND_NET_VALUE) +
            "</td>";
          htm += "</tr>";
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_searchHistory .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_searchHistory .table").html(htm);
      },
    });
  },
  //投资组合--该基金投资的十大股票
  getTenStock: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var htm = "<thead><tr>";
    htm += "<th>股票名称</th>";
    htm += '<th class="text-right">市值(万元)</th>';
    htm += '<th class="text-right">占净值比例(%)</th>';
    htm += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="18">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.tenStockParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $(".js_tenStock").parent().show();
          $(".js_tenStock").show();
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            if (k == 0) {
              $(".js_tenStock .new_date").html("查询日期:" + v.END_DATE);
            }
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap"><a href="' +
              _this.downHref02 +
              v.STOCK_CODE +
              '">' +
              v.STOCK_ABBR +
              "</a></td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' +
              _this.stringFormatter(v.VALUE) +
              "</td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + v.RATIO + "</td>";
            htm += "</tr>";
          });
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_tenStock .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_tenStock .table").html(htm);
      },
    });
  },
  //投资组合--基金持股所属行业分类前十名
  getCategoryTopTen: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var htm = "<thead><tr>";
    htm += "<th>行业</th>";
    htm += '<th class="text-right">市值(万元)</th>';
    htm += '<th class="text-right">占净值比例(%)</th>';
    htm += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="18">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.topTenParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $(".js_categoryTopTen").parent().show();
          $(".js_categoryTopTen").show();
          for (var i = 0; i < data.result.length; ++i) {
            if (i == 0) {
              $(".js_categoryTopTen .new_date").html(
                "查询日期:" + data.result[0].END_DATE
              );
            }
            if (i == 10) {
              break;
            }
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' + data.result[i].SECTORNAME + "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' +
              _this.stringFormatter(data.result[i].VALUE) +
              "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' +
              data.result[i].RATION +
              "</td>";
            htm += "</tr>";
          }
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
        }
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_categoryTopTen .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "</tbody>";
        $(".js_categoryTopTen .table").html(htm);
      },
    });
  },
  //基金净值
  getFundNetWorth: function () {

      '<tr><td>历史最高</td><td class="text-right">-</td><td>-</td></tr>';

  //历年分红情况
  getShare: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var htm = "<thead><tr>";
    htm += "<th>年份</th>";
    htm += '<th class="text-right">基金红利(元)</th>';
    htm += "<th>权益登记日</th>";
    htm += "<th>除权基准日</th>";
    htm += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="18">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.commonUrl,
      data: _this.shareParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $(".js_fundShare").show();
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            htm += "<tr>";

              '<td class="text-nowrap">' +
              v.DATE_REGISTER.substring(0, 4) +
              "</td>";

              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + v.DIVIDENDCASH + "</td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.DATE_REGISTER + "</td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.DATE_EXECUTE + "</td>";
            htm += "</tr>";
          });
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
        }
        htm += "<tbody>";
        $(".js_fundShare .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "<tbody>";
        $(".js_fundShare .table").html(htm);
      },
    });
  },
  //reits历年分红情况
  getReitsShare: function () {
    var _this = this;
    var htm = "<thead><tr>";
    htm += "<th>年份</th>";
    htm += '<th class="text-right">基金红利(元)</th>';
    htm += "<th>权益登记日</th>";
    htm += "<th>除权基准日</th>";
    htm += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    var emptyTr = '<tr><td colspan="18">暂无数据</td></tr>';
    getJSONP({
      type: "post",
      dataType: "jsonp",
      url: _this.commonSoaUrl,
      data: _this.reitShareParam,
      successCallback: function (data) {
        if (data && data.result && data.result.length > 0) {
          $(".js_reitsFundShare").show();
          $.each(data.result, function (k, v) {
            htm += "<tr>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.year.substring(0, 4) + "</td>";
            htm +=
              '<td class="text-nowrap text-right">' + Number(v.fundDividends).toFixed(4) + "</td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.rightsRegistDate + "</td>";
            htm += '<td class="text-nowrap">' + v.exrightDate + "</td>";
            htm += "</tr>";
          });
        } else {
          htm += emptyTr;
        }
        htm += "<tbody>";
        $(".js_reitsFundShare .table").html(htm);
      },
      errCallback: function () {
        htm += emptyTr;
        htm += "<tbody>";
        $(".js_reitsFundShare .table").html(htm);
      },
    });
  },
  ifNullTurn: function (turnParam) {
    if (
      turnParam == null ||
      turnParam == "" ||
      turnParam == "null" ||
      turnParam == "NULL"
    ) {
      return "-";
    } else {
      return turnParam;
    }
  },
  stringFormatter: function (d) {
    if (d == null || d == undefined || d == "null" || "" == d || "-" == d) {
      return "-";
    } else {
      if (d.indexOf(".") == -1) {
        return d;
      } else {
        if (d.substring(d.indexOf(".")).length > 1) {
          return parseFloat(d).toFixed(2);
        } else {
          return d;
        }
      }
    }
  },
};
if ($(".js_marketIndex").length > 0) {
  fundDetails.init();
}
